name: Iut.classicalABC_of_int
statement: theorem classicalABC_of_int (h : ClassicalABCInt) : ClassicalABC
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h ε hε
  refine ⟨C, fun a b c ha hb hab habc => ?_⟩
  have key := hC a b (-c) (by exact_mod_cast ha.ne') (by exact_mod_cast hb.ne')
    (by rw [neg_ne_zero]; exact_mod_cast (show 0 < c by omega).ne')
    (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr (by simpa [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast] using hab))
    (by rw [← habc]; push_cast; ring)
  have hmax : (max |(a : ℤ)| (max |(b : ℤ)| |-(c : ℤ)|)) = c := by
    rw [abs_neg]
    simp only [Nat.abs_cast]
    omega
  have hrad : (radical ((a : ℤ) * b * -(c : ℤ)) : ℤ) = (radical (a * b * c) : ℕ) := by
    rw [← Int.radical_natAbs_eq_radical]
    congr 2
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_neg]
    simp
  rw [hmax, hrad] at key
  exact_mod_cast key

name: Iut.radical_neg_int
statement: private lemma radical_neg_int (z : ℤ) : radical (-z) = radical z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.radical_natAbs_eq_radical, Int.natAbs_neg, Int.radical_natAbs_eq_radical]

name: Iut.int_bound_of_pos
statement:
private lemma int_bound_of_pos {ε C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ a b c : ℕ, 0 < a → 0 < b → Nat.Coprime a b → a + b = c →
      (c : ℝ) ≤ C * ((radical (a * b * c) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 + ε))
    {a b c : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (hab : IsCoprime a b) (habc : a + b + c = 0) :
    ((max |a| (max |b| |c|) : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ C * ((radical (a * b * c) : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ (1 + ε)
proof:
:= by
  lift a to ℕ using ha.le
  lift b to ℕ using hb.le
  have hc : c = -((a + b : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; omega
  subst hc
  have key := hC a b (a + b) (by exact_mod_cast ha) (by exact_mod_cast hb)
    (by simpa [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast] using Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp hab) rfl
  have hmax : (max |(a : ℤ)| (max |(b : ℤ)| |-((a + b : ℕ) : ℤ)|)) = ((a + b : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [abs_neg]
    simp only [Nat.abs_cast]
    omega
  have hrad : (radical ((a : ℤ) * b * -((a + b : ℕ) : ℤ)) : ℤ) =
      (radical (a * b * (a + b)) : ℕ) := by
    rw [mul_neg, radical_neg_int, ← Int.radical_natCast]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hmax, hrad]
  exact_mod_cast key

name: Iut.bound_swap12
proof:
:= by
  rwa [max_left_comm, mul_comm b a] at h

name: Iut.bound_swap23
proof:
:= by
  rwa [max_comm |c| |b|, mul_right_comm a c b] at h

name: Iut.bound_neg
proof:
:= by
  rwa [abs_neg, abs_neg, abs_neg, show -a * -b * -c = -(a * b * c) by ring,
    radical_neg_int] at h

name: Iut.classicalABCInt_of_nat
statement: theorem classicalABCInt_of_nat (h : ClassicalABC) : ClassicalABCInt
proof:
:= by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h ε hε
  refine ⟨C, fun a b c ha hb hc hab habc => ?_⟩
  have hac : IsCoprime a c := by
    have := hab.neg_right.add_mul_left_right (-1)
    rwa [show -b + a * -1 = c by omega] at this
  have hbc : IsCoprime b c := by
    have := hab.symm.neg_right.add_mul_left_right (-1)
    rwa [show -a + b * -1 = c by omega] at this
  rcases ha.lt_or_gt with ha | ha <;> rcases hb.lt_or_gt with hb | hb
  · 
    exact bound_neg (int_bound_of_pos hC (neg_pos.mpr ha) (neg_pos.mpr hb) hab.neg_neg (by omega))
  · 
    rcases hc.lt_or_gt with hc | hc
    · exact bound_swap23 (bound_neg
        (int_bound_of_pos hC (neg_pos.mpr ha) (neg_pos.mpr hc) hac.neg_neg (by omega)))
    · exact bound_swap12 (bound_swap23 (int_bound_of_pos hC hb hc hbc (by omega)))
  · 
    rcases hc.lt_or_gt with hc | hc
    · exact bound_swap12 (bound_swap23 (bound_neg
        (int_bound_of_pos hC (neg_pos.mpr hb) (neg_pos.mpr hc) hbc.neg_neg (by omega))))
    · exact bound_swap23 (int_bound_of_pos hC ha hc hac (by omega))
  · exact int_bound_of_pos hC ha hb hab habc

name: Iut.classicalABC_iff_int
statement: theorem classicalABC_iff_int : ClassicalABC ↔ ClassicalABCInt
proof:
:=
  ⟨classicalABCInt_of_nat, classicalABC_of_int⟩

name: Iut.abc_iff
statement: lemma abc_iff (T : Genl.HeightTheory) : ABC T ↔ T.StatementI
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.fact_prime
statement: lemma fact_prime : Fact P.ℓ.Prime
proof: := ⟨P.ℓ_prime⟩

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.mem_toV_iff
statement:
lemma mem_toV_iff (L : AddSubgroup P.EK.toAffine.Point) (R : ↥P.TK) :
    P.basisK R ∈ P.toV L ↔ (R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  unfold toV
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, hSR⟩
    have : S = R := P.basisK.injective hSR
    subst this
    exact (AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf).mp hS
  · intro h
    exact ⟨R, (AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf).mpr h, rfl⟩

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.toV_injective
statement:
lemma toV_injective {L L' : AddSubgroup P.EK.toAffine.Point} (hL : L ≤ P.TK) (hL' : L' ≤ P.TK)
    (h : P.toV L = P.toV L') : L = L'
proof:
:= by
  ext R
  constructor
  · intro hR
    have hRT : R ∈ P.TK := hL hR
    have := (P.mem_toV_iff L ⟨R, hRT⟩).mpr hR
    rw [h] at this
    exact (P.mem_toV_iff L' ⟨R, hRT⟩).mp this
  · intro hR
    have hRT : R ∈ P.TK := hL' hR
    have := (P.mem_toV_iff L' ⟨R, hRT⟩).mpr hR
    rw [← h] at this
    exact (P.mem_toV_iff L ⟨R, hRT⟩).mp this

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.card_toV
statement:
lemma card_toV {L : AddSubgroup P.EK.toAffine.Point} (hL : L ≤ P.TK) :
    Nat.card (P.toV L) = Nat.card L
proof:
:= by
  unfold toV
  rw [Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.equivMapOfInjective _ _ P.basisK.injective).symm.toEquiv,
    Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.addSubgroupOfEquivOfLe hL).toEquiv]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.toV_map_galK
statement:
lemma toV_map_galK (σ : Fbar ≃ₐ[F] Fbar) {L : AddSubgroup P.EK.toAffine.Point}
    (hL : L ≤ P.TK) :
    P.toV (L.map (P.galK (P.restrictK σ))) =
      (P.toV L).map (mulVecHom (P.rep σ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod P.ℓ)))
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    unfold toV at hv
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf, AddSubgroup.mem_map] at hS
    obtain ⟨R, hR, hRS⟩ := hS
    have hRT : R ∈ P.TK := hL hR
    have hS' : S = P.galTK (P.restrictK σ) ⟨R, hRT⟩ := Subtype.ext hRS.symm
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_map]
    refine ⟨P.basisK ⟨R, hRT⟩, (P.mem_toV_iff L ⟨R, hRT⟩).mpr hR, ?_⟩
    rw [mulVecHom_apply, ← P.basisK_galTK, hS']
    rfl
  · intro hv
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_map] at hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hv
    unfold toV at hu
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_map] at hu
    obtain ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩ := hu
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf] at hR
    rw [mulVecHom_apply]
    change (P.rep σ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod P.ℓ)).mulVec (P.basisK R) ∈ _
    rw [← P.basisK_galTK]
    exact (P.mem_toV_iff _ _).mpr (AddSubgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ hR)

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.e₁_ne_zero
statement: lemma e₁_ne_zero : (P.e₁ : P.EK.toAffine.Point) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := P.fact_prime
  intro h
  have h1 : P.e₁ = 0 := Subtype.ext h
  have := congrArg P.basisK h1
  simp only [e₁, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] at this
  have := congrFun this 0
  simp at this

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.e₁_mem_TK
statement: lemma e₁_mem_TK : (P.e₁ : P.EK.toAffine.Point) ∈ P.TK

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.M_le_TK
statement: lemma M_le_TK : P.M ≤ P.TK
proof: := (AddSubgroup.zmultiples_le).mpr P.e₁_mem_TK

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.card_M
statement: lemma card_M : Nat.card P.M = P.ℓ
proof:
:= by
  haveI := P.fact_prime
  unfold M
  rw [Nat.card_zmultiples]
  refine addOrderOf_eq_prime ?_ P.e₁_ne_zero
  exact (AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff).mp P.e₁_mem_TK

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.toV_M
statement: lemma toV_M : P.toV P.M = P.M₀
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  unfold toV M M₀
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff] at hS
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hS
    have : S = n • P.e₁ := Subtype.ext hn.symm
    rw [this, map_zsmul]
    simp only [e₁, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩
  · intro hv
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff] at hv
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨n • P.e₁, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf]
      exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩
    · simp only [map_zsmul, e₁, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.card_M₀
statement: lemma card_M₀ : Nat.card P.M₀ = P.ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.toV_M, P.card_toV P.M_le_TK, P.card_M]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.e₂_not_mem_M
statement: lemma e₂_not_mem_M : (P.e₂ : P.EK.toAffine.Point) ∉ P.M
proof:
:= by
  haveI := P.fact_prime
  intro h
  have := (P.mem_toV_iff P.M P.e₂).mpr h
  rw [P.toV_M] at this
  simp only [e₂, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, M₀] at this
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff] at this
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := this
  have := congrFun hn 1
  simp at this

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.single_one_not_mem_M₀
statement: lemma single_one_not_mem_M₀ : (Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → ZMod P.ℓ) ∉ P.M₀
proof:
:= by
  have := P.e₂_not_mem_M
  rwa [← P.mem_toV_iff P.M P.e₂, P.toV_M, e₂, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at this

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.nsmul_mem_of_mem_M
statement: lemma nsmul_mem_of_mem_M (R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) (hR : R ∈ P.M) : P.ℓ • R = 0
proof:
:=
  (AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff).mp (P.M_le_TK hR)

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.nsmul_mem_of_mem_M'
statement:
lemma nsmul_mem_of_mem_M' (R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) (hR : R ∈ P.M)
    (S : AddSubgroup P.EK.toAffine.Point) : P.ℓ • R ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.nsmul_mem_of_mem_M R hR]
  exact zero_mem _

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.coord₂_ker
statement: lemma coord₂_ker : P.coord₂.ker = P.M.addSubgroupOf P.TK
proof:
:= by
  ext R
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf, ← P.mem_toV_iff, P.toV_M]
  unfold M₀ coord₂
  rw [AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff]
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Pi.evalAddMonoidHom_apply,
    AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(P.basisK R 0).cast, ?_⟩
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp
    · simp [h]
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    have := congrFun hn 1
    simpa using this.symm

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.coord₂_surjective
statement: lemma coord₂_surjective : Function.Surjective P.coord₂
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  refine ⟨P.basisK.symm (Pi.single 1 a), ?_⟩
  simp [coord₂]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.QIso_toQ
statement: lemma QIso_toQ (R : ↥P.TK) : P.QIso (P.CKu.toQ R) = P.coord₂ R
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.QIso_q
statement: lemma QIso_q : P.QIso P.q = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [q, QIso_toQ]
  simp [coord₂, e₂]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.map_map_symm
statement:
lemma map_map_symm (σ : ↥P.torsionField ≃ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField)
    (R : (Affine.baseChange E ↥P.torsionField).Point) :
    Affine.Point.map (W' := E) (S := F) (σ : ↥P.torsionField →ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField)
      (Affine.Point.map (W' := E) (S := F) (σ.symm : ↥P.torsionField →ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) R) =
      R
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.Point.map_map]
  have : (σ : ↥P.torsionField →ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField).comp
      (σ.symm : ↥P.torsionField →ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) = AlgHom.id F ↥P.torsionField := by
    ext x; simp
  rw [this]
  exact Affine.Point.map_id R

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.galK_galK_symm
statement:
lemma galK_galK_symm (σ : ↥P.torsionField ≃ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) (R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) :
    P.galK σ (P.galK σ.symm R) = R
proof:
:=
  P.map_map_symm σ R

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.galK_eq
statement:
lemma galK_eq (σ : ↥P.torsionField ≃ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) :
    Iut.galK E P.torsionField σ = P.galK σ
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.exists_good_place
statement:
theorem exists_good_place {v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)} (hv : v ∈ VBad) :
    ∃ w : FinitePlace ↥P.torsionField, ∃ hwv : FinitePlace.LiesOver w v,
      TF.graphLineAt w ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩ = P.M ∧
      ∀ R, TF.IsCanonicalAt w ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩ R → (R - P.e₂ ∈ P.M ∨ R + P.e₂ ∈ P.M)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := P.fact_prime
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀⟩ := FinitePlace.exists_liesOver (K := ↥P.torsionField) v
  have hb₀ : IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad w₀ := ⟨v, hv, hw₀⟩
  have hL₀le := TF.graphLineAt_le_TK P hb₀
  have hL₀card := TF.card_graphLineAt P hb₀
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀T, hg₀L, hg₀⟩ := TF.exists_canonical P hb₀
  have hcardV : Nat.card (P.toV (TF.graphLineAt w₀ hb₀)) = P.ℓ := by
    rw [P.card_toV hL₀le, hL₀card]
  have hgV : P.basisK ⟨g₀, hg₀T⟩ ∉ P.toV (TF.graphLineAt w₀ hb₀) := fun h =>
    hg₀L ((P.mem_toV_iff _ _).mp h)
  obtain ⟨A, hAL, hAg⟩ := exists_sl2 (P.toV (TF.graphLineAt w₀ hb₀)) P.M₀ hcardV P.card_M₀ hgV
    P.single_one_not_mem_M₀
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := P.sl_le_range A
  set σ := P.restrictK τ with hσ
  have hA : (P.rep τ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod P.ℓ)) = A := by
    rw [hτ]; rfl
  have hwv : FinitePlace.LiesOver (galPlace σ w₀) v := galPlace_liesOver (fun _ => rfl) σ hw₀
  have hb : IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad (galPlace σ w₀) := ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩
  have hgl : TF.graphLineAt (galPlace σ w₀) hb = (TF.graphLineAt w₀ hb₀).map (P.galK σ) :=
    TF.graphLine_galPlace w₀ hb₀ σ
  have hLM : (TF.graphLineAt w₀ hb₀).map (P.galK σ) = P.M := by
    apply P.toV_injective (by
      rintro _ ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩
      exact P.galK_mem_TK σ (hL₀le hR)) P.M_le_TK
    rw [hσ, P.toV_map_galK τ hL₀le, hA, hAL, P.toV_M]
  refine ⟨galPlace σ w₀, hwv, hgl.trans hLM, ?_⟩
  intro R hR
  have hR₀ : TF.IsCanonicalAt w₀ hb₀ (P.galK σ.symm R) := by
    have h := TF.isCanonical_galPlace w₀ hb₀ σ (P.galK σ.symm R)
    rw [galK_eq, P.galK_galK_symm] at h
    exact h.mp hR
  
  have hσg : P.galK σ g₀ - P.e₂ ∈ P.M := by
    have h1 : P.basisK (P.galTK σ ⟨g₀, hg₀T⟩ - P.e₂) ∈ P.M₀ := by
      rw [map_sub, hσ, P.basisK_galTK, hA, e₂, AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hAg
    rw [← P.toV_M] at h1
    have h2 := (P.mem_toV_iff P.M _).mp h1
    simpa using h2
  rcases (hg₀ _).mp hR₀ with h | h
  · left
    have := AddSubgroup.mem_map_of_mem (P.galK σ) h
    rw [map_sub, P.galK_galK_symm, hLM] at this
    have := P.M.add_mem this hσg
    rwa [sub_add_sub_cancel] at this
  · right
    have := AddSubgroup.mem_map_of_mem (P.galK σ) h
    rw [map_add, P.galK_galK_symm, hLM] at this
    have h3 := P.M.sub_mem this hσg
    have h4 : R + P.galK σ g₀ - (P.galK σ g₀ - P.e₂) = R + P.e₂ := by abel
    rwa [h4] at h3

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.sectFin_liesOver
statement:
lemma sectFin_liesOver (v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)) :
    FinitePlace.LiesOver (P.sectFin TF v) v
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectFin
  split_ifs with hv
  · exact (P.exists_good_place TF hv).choose_spec.choose
  · exact (FinitePlace.exists_liesOver (K := ↥P.torsionField) v).choose_spec

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.sectFin_isBad
statement:
lemma sectFin_isBad {v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)} (hv : v ∈ VBad) :
    IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad (P.sectFin TF v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨v, hv, P.sectFin_liesOver TF v⟩

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.sectFin_eq
statement:
lemma sectFin_eq {v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)} (hv : v ∈ VBad) :
    P.sectFin TF v = (P.exists_good_place TF hv).choose
proof:
:= by
  unfold sectFin
  rw [dif_pos hv]

name: Iut.TateFamily.graphLineAt_congr
statement:
lemma _root_.Iut.TateFamily.graphLineAt_congr {w w' : FinitePlace ↥P.torsionField} (h : w = w')
    (hw : IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad w) (hw' : IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad w') :
    TF.graphLineAt w hw = TF.graphLineAt w' hw'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Iut.TateFamily.isCanonicalAt_congr
statement:
lemma _root_.Iut.TateFamily.isCanonicalAt_congr {w w' : FinitePlace ↥P.torsionField} (h : w = w')
    (hw : IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad w) (hw' : IsBadPlace E P.torsionField VBad w')
    (R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) : TF.IsCanonicalAt w hw R ↔ TF.IsCanonicalAt w' hw' R
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact Iff.rfl

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.sectFin_graphLine
statement:
lemma sectFin_graphLine {v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)} (hv : v ∈ VBad) :
    TF.graphLineAt (P.sectFin TF v) (P.sectFin_isBad TF hv) = P.M
proof:
:=
  (TF.graphLineAt_congr P (P.sectFin_eq TF hv) _ _).trans
    (P.exists_good_place TF hv).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.sectFin_canonical
statement:
lemma sectFin_canonical {v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)} (hv : v ∈ VBad) (R)
    (hR : TF.IsCanonicalAt (P.sectFin TF v) (P.sectFin_isBad TF hv) R) :
    R - P.e₂ ∈ P.M ∨ R + P.e₂ ∈ P.M
proof:
:=
  (P.exists_good_place TF hv).choose_spec.choose_spec.2 R
    ((TF.isCanonicalAt_congr P (P.sectFin_eq TF hv) _ _ R).mp hR)

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.localType
statement:
lemma localType {v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli F E)} (hv : v ∈ VBad) (b : Bool) :
    Orbicurve.IsTypeOneZModPM P.ℓ
      ((⟨P.EK, P.ℓ, P.M, b⟩ : Orbicurve ↥P.torsionField).baseChange
        (emb P.torsionField (P.sectFin TF v)))
      (TF.S _ (P.sectFin_isBad TF hv))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.ℓ_prime, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change P.M.map (pointMap P.EK (emb P.torsionField (P.sectFin TF v))) = _
    rw [← P.sectFin_graphLine TF hv]
    exact TF.map_graphLineAt P (P.sectFin_isBad TF hv)
  · rw [Orbicurve.baseChange_M, ← P.card_M]
    exact (Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.equivMapOfInjective P.M _
      (pointMap_injective P.EK (emb P.torsionField (P.sectFin TF v)))).toEquiv).symm

  exists_data F _ _ E _ Fbar _ _ _ _ P _ TF _ hcore
