    ∃ v ∈ L, v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hbot : L = ⊥ := (AddSubgroup.eq_bot_iff_forall L).mpr h
  rw [hbot, AddSubgroup.card_bot] at hL
  exact hℓ.out.one_lt.ne hL

name: Iut.Anabelian.smul_mem_zmultiples
statement:
lemma smul_mem_zmultiples (c : ZMod ℓ) (v : Fin 2 → ZMod ℓ) :
    c • v ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_cast c, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
  exact AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: Iut.Anabelian.mem_zmultiples_of_det_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mem_zmultiples_of_det_eq_zero {l g : Fin 2 → ZMod ℓ} (hl : l ≠ 0)
    (h : l 0 * g 1 - l 1 * g 0 = 0) : g ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples l
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : l 0 = 0
  · have h1 : l 1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h1
      apply hl
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1]
    have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by
      rw [h0, zero_mul, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left h1
    have : g = (g 1 / l 1) • l := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [h0, hg0]
      · simp [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h1]
    rw [this]
    exact smul_mem_zmultiples _ _
  · have : g = (g 0 / l 0) • l := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simp [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0]
      · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
        field_simp
        linear_combination h
    rw [this]
    exact smul_mem_zmultiples _ _

name: Iut.Anabelian.exists_sl2
statement:
theorem exists_sl2 (L M : AddSubgroup (Fin 2 → ZMod ℓ)) (hL : Nat.card L = ℓ)
    (hM : Nat.card M = ℓ) {g q : Fin 2 → ZMod ℓ} (hg : g ∉ L) (hq : q ∉ M) :
    ∃ A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) (ZMod ℓ),
      L.map (mulVecHom A) = M ∧ (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod ℓ)).mulVec g - q ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hlL, hl0⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_card hL
  obtain ⟨m, hmM, hm0⟩ := exists_ne_zero_of_card hM
  have hLl : L = AddSubgroup.zmultiples l := eq_zmultiples_of_card hL hlL hl0
  have hMm : M = AddSubgroup.zmultiples m := eq_zmultiples_of_card hM hmM hm0
  have hd₁ : l 0 * g 1 - l 1 * g 0 ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    hg (hLl ▸ mem_zmultiples_of_det_eq_zero hl0 h)
  have hd₂ : m 0 * q 1 - m 1 * q 0 ≠ 0 := fun h =>
    hq (hMm ▸ mem_zmultiples_of_det_eq_zero hm0 h)
  set c : ZMod ℓ := (l 0 * g 1 - l 1 * g 0) / (m 0 * q 1 - m 1 * q 0) with hc
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hd₁ hd₂
  set B₁ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod ℓ) := !![l 0, g 0; l 1, g 1] with hB₁
  set B₂ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod ℓ) := !![c * m 0, q 0; c * m 1, q 1] with hB₂
  have hdet₁ : B₁.det = l 0 * g 1 - l 1 * g 0 := by
    rw [hB₁, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]; ring
  have hdet₂ : B₂.det = c * (m 0 * q 1 - m 1 * q 0) := by
    rw [hB₂, Matrix.det_fin_two_of]; ring
  have hunit : IsUnit B₁.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hdet₁ ▸ hd₁)
  set A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod ℓ) := B₂ * B₁⁻¹ with hA
  have hdet : A.det = 1 := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, hdet₂, hdet₁, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', hc]
    field_simp
  have hAB : A * B₁ = B₂ := by
    rw [hA, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hunit, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hB₁l : B₁.mulVec (Pi.single 0 1) = l := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hB₁, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hB₁g : B₁.mulVec (Pi.single 1 1) = g := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hB₁, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hB₂m : B₂.mulVec (Pi.single 0 1) = c • m := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hB₂, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hB₂q : B₂.mulVec (Pi.single 1 1) = q := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [hB₂, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hAl : A.mulVec l = c • m := by
    rw [← hB₁l, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAB, hB₂m]
  have hAg : A.mulVec g = q := by
    rw [← hB₁g, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hAB, hB₂q]
  refine ⟨⟨A, hdet⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hcm : c • m ∈ M := hMm ▸ smul_mem_zmultiples c m
    have hcm0 : c • m ≠ 0 := smul_ne_zero hc0 hm0
    rw [hLl, AddMonoidHom.map_zmultiples, mulVecHom_apply, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mk,
      hAl]
    exact (eq_zmultiples_of_card hM hcm hcm0).symm
  · rw [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mk, hAg, sub_self]
    exact M.zero_mem

name: Iut.TateFamily.toLocal_mem_torsion
statement:
lemma toLocal_mem_torsion {R : P.EK.toAffine.Point} (hR : R ∈ P.TK) :
    toLocal P w R ∈ TateStructure.torsion P.ℓ (curveKw E P.torsionField w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff] at hR ⊢
  rw [← map_nsmul, hR, map_zero]

name: Iut.TateFamily.mem_TK_of_toLocal
statement:
lemma mem_TK_of_toLocal {R : P.EK.toAffine.Point}
    (hR : toLocal P w R ∈ TateStructure.torsion P.ℓ (curveKw E P.torsionField w)) : R ∈ P.TK
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff] at hR ⊢
  rw [← map_nsmul] at hR
  exact pointMap_injective _ _ (hR.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Iut.TateFamily.imageTK_le_torsion
statement:
lemma imageTK_le_torsion :
    imageTK P w ≤ TateStructure.torsion P.ℓ (curveKw E P.torsionField w)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩
  exact toLocal_mem_torsion P hR

name: Iut.TateFamily.card_imageTK
statement: lemma card_imageTK : Nat.card (imageTK P w) = P.ℓ * P.ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_two, ← P.card_TK]
  exact (Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.equivMapOfInjective _ _ (pointMap_injective _ _)).toEquiv).symm

name: Iut.TateFamily.sq_le_card_torsion
statement:
lemma sq_le_card_torsion :
    P.ℓ * P.ℓ ≤ Nat.card (TateStructure.torsion P.ℓ (curveKw E P.torsionField w))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (TF.S w hw).finite_torsion P.ℓ
  rw [← card_imageTK P]
  exact AddSubgroup.card_le_of_le (imageTK_le_torsion P)

name: Iut.TateFamily.torsion_surj
statement:
theorem torsion_surj :
    imageTK P w = TateStructure.torsion P.ℓ (curveKw E P.torsionField w)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := (TF.S w hw).finite_torsion P.ℓ
  apply AddSubgroup.eq_of_le_of_card_ge (imageTK_le_torsion P)
  rw [card_imageTK]
  exact (TF.S w hw).card_torsion_le P.ℓ

name: Iut.TateFamily.exists_toLocal_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← TF.torsion_surj P hw] at hQ
  exact hQ

name: Iut.TateFamily.map_graphLineAt
statement:
theorem map_graphLineAt :
    (TF.graphLineAt w hw).map (toLocal P w) = (TF.S w hw).graphLine P.ℓ
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨R, hR, rfl⟩
    exact hR
  · intro hQ
    obtain ⟨R, -, rfl⟩ := TF.exists_toLocal_eq P hw
      ((TF.S w hw).graphLine_le_torsion P.ℓ hQ)
    exact ⟨R, hQ, rfl⟩

name: Iut.TateFamily.card_graphLineAt
statement: theorem card_graphLineAt : Nat.card (TF.graphLineAt w hw) = P.ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Nat.card (TF.graphLineAt w hw) =
      Nat.card ((TF.graphLineAt w hw).map (toLocal P w)) :=
    Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.equivMapOfInjective _ _ (pointMap_injective _ _)).toEquiv
  rw [h1, TF.map_graphLineAt P hw]
  exact (TF.S w hw).card_graphLine_eq P.ℓ (TF.sq_le_card_torsion P hw)

name: Iut.TateFamily.graphLineAt_le_TK
statement: theorem graphLineAt_le_TK : TF.graphLineAt w hw ≤ P.TK
proof:
:= fun R hR =>
  mem_TK_of_toLocal P ((TF.S w hw).graphLine_le_torsion P.ℓ hR)

name: Iut.TateFamily.exists_canonical
statement:
theorem exists_canonical :
    ∃ g ∈ P.TK, g ∉ TF.graphLineAt w hw ∧
      ∀ R, TF.IsCanonicalAt w hw R ↔
        (R - g ∈ TF.graphLineAt w hw ∨ R + g ∈ TF.graphLineAt w hw)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u₁, m₁, hu₁⟩ := (TF.S w hw).exists_root_class P.ℓ (TF.sq_le_card_torsion P hw)
  obtain ⟨g, hgT, hg⟩ := TF.exists_toLocal_eq P hw ((TF.S w hw).ofUnit_mem_torsion P.ℓ hu₁)
  refine ⟨g, hgT, ?_, fun R => ?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply (TF.S w hw).ofUnit_not_mem_graphLine P.ℓ hu₁
    rw [← hg]
    exact h
  · unfold IsCanonicalAt
    rw [(TF.S w hw).isCanonical_iff P.ℓ hu₁, ← hg]
    unfold graphLineAt
    rw [AddSubgroup.mem_comap, AddSubgroup.mem_comap, map_sub, map_add]

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.cuspOf_neg
statement:
lemma cuspOf_neg (X : Orbicurve k) (hpm : X.pm = true) (q : X.Q) :
    X.cuspOf (-q) = X.cuspOf q
proof:
:=
  Quot.sound (Or.inr ⟨hpm, rfl⟩)

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.baseChange_E
statement: lemma baseChange_E (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) : (X.baseChange f).E = X.E.map f
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.baseChange_level
statement:
lemma baseChange_level (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) :
    (X.baseChange f).level = X.level
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.baseChange_M
statement:
lemma baseChange_M (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) :
    (X.baseChange f).M = X.M.map (pointMap X.E f)
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.baseChange_pm
statement: lemma baseChange_pm (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) : (X.baseChange f).pm = X.pm
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.baseChange_oncePunctured
statement:
lemma baseChange_oncePunctured (f : k →+* K) (E : WeierstrassCurve k) [E.IsElliptic] :
    (oncePunctured E).baseChange f = oncePunctured (E.map f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseChange, oncePunctured]
  congr 1
  exact AddSubgroup.map_bot _

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.baseChange_pmQuotient
statement:
lemma baseChange_pmQuotient (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) :
    (pmQuotient X).baseChange f = pmQuotient (X.baseChange f)
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.pointMap_mem_torsion
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff] at hP ⊢
  rw [← map_nsmul, hP, map_zero]

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.coe_mapTorsion
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_mapTorsion (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) (P : ↥X.torsion) :
    ((X.mapTorsion f P : ↥(X.baseChange f).torsion) : (X.baseChange f).E.toAffine.Point) =
      pointMap X.E f P
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.mapQ_toQ
statement:
lemma mapQ_toQ (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) (P : ↥X.torsion) :
    X.mapQ f (X.toQ P) = (X.baseChange f).toQ (X.mapTorsion f P)
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.cuspBaseChange_cuspOf
statement:
lemma cuspBaseChange_cuspOf (f : k →+* K) (X : Orbicurve k) (q : X.Q) :
    X.cuspBaseChange f (X.cuspOf q) = (X.baseChange f).cuspOf (X.mapQ f q)
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.transportM_rfl
statement:
@[simp] lemma transportM_rfl {E : WeierstrassCurve k} (M : AddSubgroup E.toAffine.Point) :
    transportM rfl M = M
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.transport_comp
proof:
:= by
  subst h h'
  intro P hP
  rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]
  exact hM' _ (hM P hP)

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.transport_baseChange
statement:
lemma transport_baseChange (f : k →+* K) {E E' : WeierstrassCurve k} (h : E = E') (n : ℕ)
    {M : AddSubgroup E.toAffine.Point} {M' : AddSubgroup E'.toAffine.Point}
    (hM : ∀ P ∈ M, n • P ∈ transportM h.symm M') :
    ∀ P ∈ M.map (pointMap E f),
      n • P ∈ transportM (congrArg (WeierstrassCurve.map · f) h).symm (M'.map (pointMap E' f))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rintro _ ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
  show n • pointMap E f P ∈ M'.map (pointMap E f)
  rw [← map_nsmul]
  exact AddSubgroup.mem_map_of_mem _ (hM P hP)

name: Iut.TateStructure.norm_q_lt_one
statement: lemma norm_q_lt_one : ‖(S.t.q : k)‖ < 1
proof: := S.t.norm_lt_one

name: Iut.TateStructure.norm_q_pos
statement: lemma norm_q_pos : 0 < ‖(S.t.q : k)‖
proof: := S.t.norm_q_pos

name: Iut.TateStructure.q_zpow_injective
statement: lemma q_zpow_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℤ => S.t.q ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have h' : ‖((S.t.q ^ a : kˣ) : k)‖ = ‖((S.t.q ^ b : kˣ) : k)‖ := by
    simp only at h
    rw [h]
  rw [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, norm_zpow, norm_zpow] at h'
  exact zpow_right_injective₀ S.norm_q_pos S.norm_q_lt_one.ne h'

name: Iut.TateStructure.ofUnit_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma ofUnit_eq_zero_iff (u : kˣ) : S.ofUnit u = 0 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, u = S.t.q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S.ofUnit_one, S.ofUnit_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine ⟨-n, ?_⟩
    rw [zpow_neg]
    exact eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hn.symm
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-n, by rw [zpow_neg, inv_mul_cancel]⟩

name: Iut.TateStructure.nsmul_ofUnit
statement: lemma nsmul_ofUnit (n : ℕ) (u : kˣ) : n • S.ofUnit u = S.ofUnit (u ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ofUnit
  rw [← map_nsmul]
  rfl

name: Iut.TateStructure.ofUnit_mem_torsionBy_iff
statement:
lemma ofUnit_mem_torsionBy_iff (ℓ : ℕ) (u : kˣ) :
    S.ofUnit u ∈ AddSubgroup.torsionBy E.toAffine.Point ℓ ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, u ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff, nsmul_ofUnit, ofUnit_eq_zero_iff]

name: Iut.TateStructure.expo_congr
statement:
lemma expo_congr (ℓ : ℕ) {u v : kˣ} {n m : ℤ} (huv : S.ofUnit u = S.ofUnit v)
    (hu : u ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ n) (hv : v ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ m) : (m : ZMod ℓ) = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (S.ofUnit_eq_iff u v).mp huv
  have h : S.t.q ^ m = S.t.q ^ (j * ℓ + n) := by
    rw [← hv, hj, mul_pow, hu, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add]
  have hm := S.q_zpow_injective h
  rw [hm]
  push_cast
  simp

name: Iut.TateStructure.exists_rep
statement:
lemma exists_rep (P : ↥(torsion ℓ E)) :
    ∃ u : kˣ, S.ofUnit u = P ∧ ∃ n : ℤ, u ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := S.ofUnit_surjective P.1
  exact ⟨u, hu, (S.ofUnit_mem_torsionBy_iff ℓ u).mp (hu ▸ P.2)⟩

name: Iut.TateStructure.ofUnit_rep
statement: lemma ofUnit_rep (P : ↥(torsion ℓ E)) : S.ofUnit (S.rep ℓ P) = P
proof:
:=
  (S.exists_rep ℓ P).choose_spec.1

name: Iut.TateStructure.rep_pow
statement: lemma rep_pow (P : ↥(torsion ℓ E)) : S.rep ℓ P ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ S.expo ℓ P
proof:
:=
  (S.exists_rep ℓ P).choose_spec.2.choose_spec

name: Iut.TateStructure.resid_apply
statement: lemma resid_apply (P : ↥(torsion ℓ E)) : S.resid ℓ P = (S.expo ℓ P : ZMod ℓ)
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.TateStructure.resid_ofUnit
statement:
lemma resid_ofUnit {u : kˣ} {n : ℤ} (hu : u ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ n) (hP : S.ofUnit u ∈ torsion ℓ E) :
    S.resid ℓ ⟨S.ofUnit u, hP⟩ = (n : ZMod ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resid_apply]
  exact S.expo_congr ℓ (S.ofUnit_rep ℓ ⟨S.ofUnit u, hP⟩).symm hu (S.rep_pow ℓ _)

name: Iut.TateStructure.resid_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma resid_eq_zero_iff (P : ↥(torsion ℓ E)) :
    S.resid ℓ P = 0 ↔ (P : E.toAffine.Point) ∈ S.graphLine ℓ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [resid_apply, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h
    refine ⟨S.rep ℓ P * (S.t.q ^ j)⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mul_pow, rep_pow, hj, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm (j : ℤ),
        mul_inv_cancel]
    · rw [ofUnit_mul, ofUnit_rep, (S.ofUnit_eq_zero_iff (S.t.q ^ j)⁻¹).mpr ⟨-j, by rw [zpow_neg]⟩,
        add_zero]
  · rintro ⟨ζ, hζ, hζP⟩
    have := S.expo_congr ℓ (hζP.trans (S.ofUnit_rep ℓ P).symm) (by rw [hζ, zpow_zero])
      (S.rep_pow ℓ P)
    rw [resid_apply, this]
    simp

name: Iut.TateStructure.graphLine_le_torsion
statement: lemma graphLine_le_torsion : S.graphLine ℓ ≤ torsion ℓ E
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨ζ, hζ, rfl⟩
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff, nsmul_ofUnit, hζ, ofUnit_one]

name: Iut.TateStructure.ofUnit_rootsOfUnity_surjective
statement:
lemma ofUnit_rootsOfUnity_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (fun ζ : rootsOfUnity ℓ k =>
      (⟨S.ofUnit ζ.1, ⟨ζ.1, (mem_rootsOfUnity ℓ ζ.1).mp ζ.2, rfl⟩⟩ : ↥(S.graphLine ℓ)))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨P, ζ, hζ, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨ζ, (mem_rootsOfUnity ℓ ζ).mpr hζ⟩, rfl⟩

name: Iut.TateStructure.card_graphLine_le
statement: lemma card_graphLine_le : Nat.card ↥(S.graphLine ℓ) ≤ ℓ
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ (S.ofUnit_rootsOfUnity_surjective ℓ)).trans
    (card_rootsOfUnity (R := k) (k := ℓ))

name: Iut.TateStructure.resid_ker
statement: lemma resid_ker : (S.resid ℓ).ker = (S.graphLine ℓ).addSubgroupOf (torsion ℓ E)
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  rw [AddMonoidHom.mem_ker, AddSubgroup.mem_addSubgroupOf, resid_eq_zero_iff]

name: Iut.TateStructure.card_torsion_eq
statement:
lemma card_torsion_eq :
    Nat.card ↥(torsion ℓ E) = Nat.card ↥(S.graphLine ℓ) * Nat.card ↥(S.resid ℓ).range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AddSubgroup.card_mul_index (S.resid ℓ).ker, AddSubgroup.index_eq_card, resid_ker]
  congr 1
  · exact Nat.card_congr (AddSubgroup.addSubgroupOfEquivOfLe (S.graphLine_le_torsion ℓ)).toEquiv
  · rw [← resid_ker]
    exact Nat.card_congr (QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivRange (S.resid ℓ)).toEquiv

name: Iut.TateStructure.card_range_le
statement: lemma card_range_le : Nat.card ↥(S.resid ℓ).range ≤ ℓ
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ Subtype.val_injective).trans (by rw [Nat.card_zmod])

name: Iut.TateStructure.card_torsion_le
statement: lemma card_torsion_le : Nat.card ↥(torsion ℓ E) ≤ ℓ * ℓ
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.card_torsion_eq ℓ]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul (S.card_graphLine_le ℓ) (S.card_range_le ℓ)

name: Iut.TateStructure.finite_torsion
statement: theorem finite_torsion : Finite ↥(torsion ℓ E)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero
  rw [S.card_torsion_eq ℓ]
  exact Nat.mul_ne_zero Nat.card_pos.ne' Nat.card_pos.ne'

name: Iut.TateStructure.eq_of_mul_ge
statement:
lemma eq_of_mul_ge {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ ℓ) (hb : b ≤ ℓ) (h : ℓ * ℓ ≤ a * b) :
    a = ℓ ∧ b = ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hℓ : 0 < ℓ := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne ℓ)
  have hab : a * b ≤ ℓ * ℓ := Nat.mul_le_mul ha hb
  constructor
  · by_contra hne
    have : a < ℓ := lt_of_le_of_ne ha hne
    have : a * b ≤ a * ℓ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a hb
    nlinarith
  · by_contra hne
    have : b < ℓ := lt_of_le_of_ne hb hne
    have : a * b ≤ ℓ * b := Nat.mul_le_mul_right b ha
    nlinarith

name: Iut.TateStructure.card_graphLine_eq
statement: lemma card_graphLine_eq : Nat.card ↥(S.graphLine ℓ) = ℓ
proof:
:=
  (eq_of_mul_ge ℓ (S.card_graphLine_le ℓ) (S.card_range_le ℓ) (by rwa [← S.card_torsion_eq])).1

name: Iut.TateStructure.resid_range_eq_top
statement: lemma resid_range_eq_top : (S.resid ℓ).range = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply AddSubgroup.eq_top_of_card_eq
  rw [Nat.card_zmod]
  exact (eq_of_mul_ge ℓ (S.card_graphLine_le ℓ) (S.card_range_le ℓ)
    (by rwa [← S.card_torsion_eq])).2

name: Iut.TateStructure.exists_root_class
statement: lemma exists_root_class : ∃ u : kˣ, ∃ m : ℤ, u ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ (1 + ℓ * m)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : ZMod ℓ) ∈ (S.resid ℓ).range := by rw [S.resid_range_eq_top ℓ h2]; trivial
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := h1
  rw [resid_apply, ← sub_eq_zero, ← Int.cast_one, ← Int.cast_sub,
    ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hP
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hP
  refine ⟨S.rep ℓ P, m, ?_⟩
  rw [rep_pow]
  congr 1
  linarith

name: Iut.TateStructure.mem_graphLine_of_pow_eq
statement:
lemma mem_graphLine_of_pow_eq {u : kˣ} {j : ℤ} (h : u ^ ℓ = S.t.q ^ (ℓ * j)) :
    S.ofUnit u ∈ S.graphLine ℓ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨u * (S.t.q ^ j)⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [mul_pow, h, inv_pow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm (j : ℤ), mul_inv_cancel]
  · rw [ofUnit_mul, (S.ofUnit_eq_zero_iff (S.t.q ^ j)⁻¹).mpr ⟨-j, by rw [zpow_neg]⟩, add_zero]

name: Iut.TateStructure.isCanonical_ofUnit
statement: lemma isCanonical_ofUnit : S.IsCanonical ℓ (S.ofUnit u₁)
proof: := ⟨u₁, rfl, m₁, Or.inl hu₁⟩

name: Iut.TateStructure.ofUnit_mem_torsion
statement: lemma ofUnit_mem_torsion : S.ofUnit u₁ ∈ torsion ℓ E
proof:
:=
  (S.ofUnit_mem_torsionBy_iff ℓ u₁).mpr ⟨_, hu₁⟩

name: Iut.TateStructure.ofUnit_not_mem_graphLine
statement: lemma ofUnit_not_mem_graphLine [Fact (1 < ℓ)] : S.ofUnit u₁ ∉ S.graphLine ℓ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (S.resid_eq_zero_iff ℓ ⟨_, S.ofUnit_mem_torsion ℓ hu₁⟩).mpr h
  rw [S.resid_ofUnit ℓ hu₁] at this
  simp at this

name: Iut.TateStructure.isCanonical_iff
statement:
lemma isCanonical_iff (P : E.toAffine.Point) :
    S.IsCanonical ℓ P ↔
      P - S.ofUnit u₁ ∈ S.graphLine ℓ ∨ P + S.ofUnit u₁ ∈ S.graphLine ℓ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl, m, hu | hu⟩
    · left
      rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← ofUnit_inv, ← ofUnit_mul]
      apply S.mem_graphLine_of_pow_eq ℓ (j := m - m₁)
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, hu, hu₁, ← zpow_neg, ← zpow_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    · right
      rw [← ofUnit_mul]
      apply S.mem_graphLine_of_pow_eq ℓ (j := m + m₁)
      rw [mul_pow, hu, hu₁, ← zpow_add]
      congr 1
      ring
  · rintro (⟨ζ, hζ, hζP⟩ | ⟨ζ, hζ, hζP⟩)
    · refine ⟨ζ * u₁, ?_, m₁, Or.inl ?_⟩
      · rw [ofUnit_mul, hζP, sub_add_cancel]
      · rw [mul_pow, hζ, one_mul, hu₁]
    · refine ⟨ζ * u₁⁻¹, ?_, -m₁, Or.inr ?_⟩
      · rw [ofUnit_mul, ofUnit_inv, hζP, add_neg_cancel_right]
      · rw [mul_pow, hζ, one_mul, inv_pow, hu₁, ← zpow_neg]
        congr 1
        ring

name: Iut.Anabelian.Orbicurve.temperedPresentation_of_charZero
statement:
lemma Orbicurve.temperedPresentation_of_charZero {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    (X : Orbicurve k) :
    X.temperedPresentation = ⟨Genuine.orbifold X.E X.level X.M X.pm,
      ((Genuine.etaleEquiv X.E X.level X.M X.pm).trans
        (Genuine.pi1EquivC X.E X.level X.M X.pm)).toMulEquiv.toMonoidHom,
      ((Genuine.etaleEquiv X.E X.level X.M X.pm).trans
        (Genuine.pi1EquivC X.E X.level X.M X.pm)).continuous⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Orbicurve.temperedPresentation, dif_pos (inferInstance : CharZero k)]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.bcK_injective
statement: lemma bcK_injective : Function.Injective P.bcK
proof:
:=
  Affine.Point.map_injective (W' := E) (S := F) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥P.torsionField Fbar)

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.galPointMap_eq_of_mem_ker
statement:
lemma galPointMap_eq_of_mem_ker {σ : Fbar ≃ₐ[F] Fbar} (hσ : σ ∈ P.rep.ker) (Q : ↥P.TFbar) :
    galPointMap F E Fbar σ Q.1 = Q.1
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.rep_spec σ Q
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hσ] at h
  simp only [Units.val_one, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (P.torsionBasis.injective h)

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.exists_bcK_eq
statement:
lemma exists_bcK_eq (Q : Affine.Point (Affine.baseChange E Fbar)) (hQ : Q ∈ P.TFbar) :
    ∃ R : P.EK.toAffine.Point, P.bcK R = Q
proof:
:= by
  rcases Q with _ | ⟨x, y, h⟩
  · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · have hfix : ∀ σ ∈ P.rep.ker, σ x = x ∧ σ y = y := by
      intro σ hσ
      have h' := P.galPointMap_eq_of_mem_ker hσ ⟨_, hQ⟩
      simp only [galPointMap, Affine.Point.map_some] at h'
      exact Affine.Point.some.inj h'
    have hx : x ∈ P.torsionField := by
      rw [Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.torsionField, IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
      exact fun σ hσ => (hfix σ hσ).1
    have hy : y ∈ P.torsionField := by
      rw [Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.torsionField, IntermediateField.mem_fixedField_iff]
      exact fun σ hσ => (hfix σ hσ).2
    have hns : (Affine.baseChange E ↥P.torsionField).Nonsingular
        (⟨x, hx⟩ : ↥P.torsionField) ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
      (Affine.baseChange_nonsingular (W := E)
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥P.torsionField Fbar).injective _ _).mp h
    exact ⟨.some _ _ hns, rfl⟩

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.bcK_mem_TFbar
statement: lemma bcK_mem_TFbar {R : P.EK.toAffine.Point} (hR : R ∈ P.TK) : P.bcK R ∈ P.TFbar
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff] at hR ⊢
  rw [← map_nsmul, hR, map_zero]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.mem_TK_of_bcK
statement: lemma mem_TK_of_bcK {R : P.EK.toAffine.Point} (hR : P.bcK R ∈ P.TFbar) : R ∈ P.TK
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff] at hR ⊢
  rw [← map_nsmul] at hR
  exact P.bcK_injective (hR.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.coe_torsionEquiv
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_torsionEquiv (R : ↥P.TK) : (P.torsionEquiv R : Affine.Point _) = P.bcK R
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.card_TK
statement: lemma card_TK : Nat.card P.TK = P.ℓ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr P.basisK.toEquiv, Nat.card_pi, Nat.card_zmod]
  simp

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.map_map_restrictK
statement:
lemma map_map_restrictK (σ : Fbar ≃ₐ[F] Fbar)
    (R : (Affine.baseChange E ↥P.torsionField).Point) :
    Affine.Point.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥P.torsionField Fbar)
      (Affine.Point.map (W' := E) (S := F)
        (P.restrictK σ : ↥P.torsionField →ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) R) =
      Affine.Point.map (W' := E) (S := F) σ.toAlgHom
        (Affine.Point.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥P.torsionField Fbar) R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Affine.Point.map_map, Affine.Point.map_map]
  have h : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥P.torsionField Fbar).comp
      (P.restrictK σ : ↥P.torsionField →ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) =
      σ.toAlgHom.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F ↥P.torsionField Fbar) := by
    ext x
    exact AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom_apply P.torsionField σ x
  rw [h]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.bcK_galK
statement:
lemma bcK_galK (σ : Fbar ≃ₐ[F] Fbar) (R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) :
    P.bcK (P.galK (P.restrictK σ) R) = galPointMap F E Fbar σ (P.bcK R)
proof:
:=
  P.map_map_restrictK σ R

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.galK_mem_TK
statement:
lemma galK_mem_TK (σ : ↥P.torsionField ≃ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) {R : P.EK.toAffine.Point}
    (hR : R ∈ P.TK) : P.galK σ R ∈ P.TK
proof:
:= by
  rw [AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff] at hR ⊢
  rw [← map_nsmul, hR, map_zero]

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.coe_galTK
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_galTK (σ : ↥P.torsionField ≃ₐ[F] ↥P.torsionField) (R : ↥P.TK) :
    (P.galTK σ R : P.EK.toAffine.Point) = P.galK σ R
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.AdmissiblePrimeData.basisK_galTK
statement:
lemma basisK_galTK (σ : Fbar ≃ₐ[F] Fbar) (R : ↥P.TK) :
    P.basisK (P.galTK (P.restrictK σ) R) =
      (P.rep σ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod P.ℓ)).mulVec (P.basisK R)
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.rep_spec σ (P.torsionEquiv R)
  unfold basisK
  simp only [AddEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [← h]
  congr 1
  ext
  simp only [coe_torsionEquiv, coe_galTK]
  exact P.bcK_galK σ R

name: Iut.LocalTheory.toRational_finite
statement:
@[simp] lemma toRational_finite (w : FinitePlace K) :
    LT.toRational (Place.finite w) = .finite ⟨residueChar w, LT.residueChar_prime w⟩
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.LocalTheory.toRational_infinite
statement:
@[simp] lemma toRational_infinite (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    LT.toRational (Place.infinite w) = .infinite
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.LocalTheory.tuple_isOver
statement:
lemma tuple_isOver {ι : Type} (p : Nat.Primes) (c : ι → LT.Fiber (.finite p)) :
    ∀ j, ∃ w : FinitePlace K, LT.tuple _ c j = Place.finite w ∧ residueChar w = p
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  have hv := (c j).2
  change LT.toRational (LT.tuple _ c j) = _ at hv
  rcases hw : LT.tuple _ c j with w | w
  · rw [hw] at hv
    exact ⟨w, rfl, congrArg Subtype.val (RationalPlace.finite.inj hv)⟩
  · rw [hw] at hv
    exact absurd hv (by simp [toRational])

name: Iut.LocalTheory.productRegion_eq_pi
statement:
lemma productRegion_eq_pi {C : Type*} (P : DirectSumPresentation C)
    (U : ∀ c, Set (P.Summand c)) : P.productRegion U = Set.pi Set.univ U
proof:
:= by
  ext x; exact ⟨fun h c _ => h c, fun h c => h c (Set.mem_univ c)⟩

name: Iut.LocalTheory.isCompact_closure_productRegion
statement:
lemma isCompact_closure_productRegion {C : Type*} (P : DirectSumPresentation C)
    (U : ∀ c, Set (P.Summand c)) (hU : ∀ c, IsCompact (closure (U c))) :
    IsCompact (closure (P.productRegion U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [productRegion_eq_pi]
  change IsCompact (closure (Set.pi Set.univ U : Set (∀ c, P.Summand c)))
  rw [closure_pi_set]
  exact isCompact_univ_pi hU

name: Iut.LocalTheory.container_proc
statement: @[simp] lemma container_proc : (LT.container n).proc = Procession.standard n
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.LocalTheory.finrank_pos
statement: lemma finrank_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast Module.finrank_pos

name: Iut.LocalTheory.weight_pos
statement: lemma weight_pos (vQ : RationalPlace) (v : LT.Fiber vQ) : 0 < LT.weight vQ v
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨v, hv⟩
  rcases v with w | w
  · change 0 < placeWeight K w
    exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast LT.localDeg_pos w) finrank_pos
  · change 0 < infPlaceWeight K w
    exact div_pos (by exact_mod_cast w.mult_pos) finrank_pos

name: Iut.LocalTheory.weight_sum_one
statement: lemma weight_sum_one (vQ : RationalPlace) : ∑ v, LT.weight vQ v = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases vQ with p | _
  · haveI := LT.fiber_finite p
    haveI : Fintype {w : FinitePlace K // residueChar w = p} := Fintype.ofFinite _
    have hsum := LT.sum_localDeg p p.2
    rw [Fintype.sum_equiv (LT.fiberFiniteEquiv p) (fun v => LT.weight (.finite p) v)
      (fun w => placeWeight K w.1)
      (fun v => by
        rcases v with ⟨v, hv⟩
        rcases v with w | w
        · rfl
        · exact absurd hv (by simp [toRational]))]
    simp only [placeWeight, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq finrank_pos.ne']
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum, hsum]
  · rw [Fintype.sum_equiv LT.fiberInfiniteEquiv (fun v => LT.weight .infinite v)
      (fun w => infPlaceWeight K w)
      (fun v => by
        rcases v with ⟨v, hv⟩
        rcases v with w | w
        · exact absurd hv (by simp [toRational])
        · rfl)]
    simp only [infPlaceWeight, ← Finset.sum_div]
    rw [div_eq_one_iff_eq finrank_pos.ne']
    exact_mod_cast LT.sum_mult

name: Iut.LocalTheory.proj_productRegion
statement:
lemma proj_productRegion {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (vQ : RationalPlace)
    (U : ∀ c : ι → LT.Fiber vQ, Set (LT.Tensor vQ (LT.tuple vQ c)))
    (hU : ∀ c, (U c).Nonempty) (c : ι → LT.Fiber vQ) :
    LT.proj vQ c ((LT.packet ι vQ).productRegion U) = U c
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx c
  · intro hy
    classical
    refine ⟨Function.update (fun c' => (hU c').some) c y, fun c' => ?_, by simp⟩
    by_cases h : c' = c
    · subst h; rw [Function.update_self]; exact hy
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne h]; exact (hU c').some_mem

name: Iut.LocalTheory.isHullRegion_of_mem_hullRegions
statement:
lemma isHullRegion_of_mem_hullRegions (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (vQ : RationalPlace) :
    ∀ R ∈ LT.hullRegions ι vQ, (LT.packet ι vQ).IsHullRegion R
proof:
:= by
  cases vQ with
  | finite p => exact fun R hR => hR
  | infinite =>
    rintro R ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, fun c => (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ht c).ne').map
      (algebraMap ℝ (LT.Tensor .infinite (LT.tuple .infinite c))), rfl⟩

name: Iut.LocalTheory.integralRegion_mem_hullRegions
statement:
lemma integralRegion_mem_hullRegions (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (vQ : RationalPlace) :
    (LT.packet ι vQ).integralRegion ∈ LT.hullRegions ι vQ
proof:
:= by
  cases vQ with
  | finite p => exact (LT.packet ι (.finite p)).isHullRegion_integralRegion
  | infinite =>
    refine ⟨fun _ => 1, fun _ => one_pos, ?_⟩
    rw [← DirectSumPresentation.scaledIntegral_one]
    congr 1
    funext c
    exact (map_one _).symm

name: Iut.LocalTheory.exists_leastHullRegion
statement:
lemma exists_leastHullRegion (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (vQ : RationalPlace)
    (fam : ∀ c : ι → LT.Fiber vQ, Set (LT.Tensor vQ (LT.tuple vQ c)))
    (hfam : ∀ c, fam c ∈ LT.admissible vQ (LT.tuple vQ c)) :
    ∃ R, (LT.packet ι vQ).IsLeastHullRegionIn (LT.hullRegions ι vQ)
      ((LT.packet ι vQ).productRegion fam) R
proof:
:= by
  cases vQ with
  | finite p =>
    choose a ha using fun c => LT.exists_leastHull p (LT.tuple _ c) (fam c) (hfam c)
    refine ⟨(LT.packet _ _).scaledIntegral a, ⟨a, fun c => (ha c).1, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx c
      exact (ha c).2.1 (hx c)
    · rintro R ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ hUR
      intro x hx c
      have hproj : fam c ⊆ LT.scaled _ c (b c) := by
        have := LT.proj_productRegion _ fam
          (fun c => LT.admissible_nonempty _ _ _ (hfam c)) c
        rw [← this]
        rintro y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        exact hUR hz c
      exact (ha c).2.2 (b c) (hb c) hproj (hx c)
  | infinite =>
    choose t ht using fun c => LT.exists_leastHull_infinite (LT.tuple _ c) (fam c) (hfam c)
    refine ⟨(LT.packet _ _).scaledIntegral fun c =>
      algebraMap ℝ (LT.Tensor .infinite (LT.tuple .infinite c)) (t c),
      ⟨t, fun c => (ht c).1, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx c
      exact (ht c).2.1 (hx c)
    · rintro R ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ hUR
      intro x hx c
      have hproj : fam c ⊆ algebraMap ℝ (LT.Tensor .infinite (LT.tuple .infinite c)) (t' c) •
          LT.integral .infinite (LT.tuple .infinite c) := by
        have := LT.proj_productRegion _ fam
          (fun c => LT.admissible_nonempty _ _ _ (hfam c)) c
        rw [← this]
        rintro y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
        exact hUR hz c
      exact LT.smul_integral_infinite_mono _ _ _ (ht c).1
        ((ht c).2.2 (t' c) (ht' c) hproj) (hx c)

name: Iut.natCast_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
lemma natCast_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (v : FinitePlace k) {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) :
    (q : 𝓞 k) ∈ v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ↔ residueChar v = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_natCast,
    CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (𝓞 k ⧸ v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) (ringChar _)]
  exact Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq (residueChar_prime v) hq

name: Iut.residueChar_eq_of_liesOver_place
statement:
lemma residueChar_eq_of_liesOver_place {w : FinitePlace K} {v : FinitePlace k}
    (hwv : FinitePlace.LiesOver w v) : residueChar w = residueChar v
proof:
:= by
  haveI : w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := hwv
  haveI : v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.IsMaximal :=
    v.maximalIdeal.isPrime.isMaximal v.maximalIdeal.ne_bot
  letI : Field (𝓞 k ⧸ v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  haveI : CharP (𝓞 k ⧸ v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) (residueChar v) := ringChar.of_eq rfl
  haveI : CharP (𝓞 K ⧸ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) (residueChar v) :=
    charP_of_injective_algebraMap
      (algebraMap (𝓞 k ⧸ v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) (𝓞 K ⧸ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal)).injective
      (residueChar v)
  exact ringChar.eq _ (residueChar v)

name: Iut.valuation_j_le_one_of_good
statement:
lemma valuation_j_le_one_of_good (hw : HasGoodReductionAt E w) :
    w.maximalIdeal.valuation F E.j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hw
  haveI : ((C • E).baseChange (w.maximalIdeal.adicCompletion F)).HasGoodReduction
    (w.maximalIdeal.adicCompletionIntegers F) := hC
  have hΔ : ‖((C • E).baseChange (w.maximalIdeal.adicCompletion F)).Δ‖ = 1 :=
    (valuation_eq_one_iff w _).1 HasGoodReduction.goodReduction
  have hc₄ : ‖((C • E).baseChange (w.maximalIdeal.adicCompletion F)).c₄‖ ≤ 1 := norm_c₄_le_one _
  rw [baseChange_adicCompletion_eq, map_Δ] at hΔ
  rw [baseChange_adicCompletion_eq, map_c₄] at hc₄
  rw [← variableChange_j E C, ← norm_emb_le_one_iff, j_eq_inv_Δ_mul, map_mul, map_inv₀,
    map_pow, norm_mul, norm_inv, norm_pow, hΔ, inv_one, one_mul]
  exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) hc₄

name: Iut.hasMultiplicativeReductionAt_iff_of_stable
statement:
lemma hasMultiplicativeReductionAt_iff_of_stable (hst : HasStableReductionAt E w) :
    HasMultiplicativeReductionAt E w ↔ ¬ w.maximalIdeal.valuation F E.j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hw
    exact not_le.2 (one_lt_valuation_j_of_mult E w hw)
  · intro h
    rcases hst with hg | hm
    · exact absurd (valuation_j_le_one_of_good E w hg) h
    · exact hm

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.exists_liesOver
statement:
lemma exists_liesOver (w : FinitePlace C.F) :
    ∃ v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli C.F C.E), FinitePlace.LiesOver w v
proof:
:=
  ⟨placeUnder w, liesOver_placeUnder w⟩

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.residueChar_liesOver
statement:
lemma residueChar_liesOver (v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli C.F C.E)) (w : FinitePlace C.F)
    (hwv : FinitePlace.LiesOver w v) : residueChar w = residueChar v
proof:
:=
  residueChar_eq_of_liesOver_place hwv

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.inertDeg_pos
statement: lemma inertDeg_pos (w : FinitePlace C.F) : 0 < inertDeg C.F w
proof:
:=
  Ideal.inertiaDeg_pos w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ℤ

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.badAll_finite
statement: lemma badAll_finite : C.badAll.Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : C.E.j = 0
  · refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_empty) ?_
    intro w hw
    have := one_lt_valuation_j_of_mult C.E w hw
    rw [hj, map_zero] at this
    exact absurd this (not_lt.2 zero_le_one)
  refine (FinitePlace.hasFiniteMulSupport hj).subset ?_
  intro w hw
  rw [Function.mem_mulSupport, ← FinitePlace.norm_embedding_eq]
  intro h
  exact absurd ((norm_emb_le_one_iff _).1 h.le) (not_le.2 (one_lt_valuation_j_of_mult C.E w hw))

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.mult_invariant
statement:
lemma mult_invariant (hst : ∀ w : FinitePlace C.F, HasStableReductionAt C.E w)
    (v : FinitePlace ↥(fieldOfModuli C.F C.E)) (w w' : FinitePlace C.F)
    (hw : FinitePlace.LiesOver w v) (hw' : FinitePlace.LiesOver w' v)
    (hm : HasMultiplicativeReductionAt C.E w) : HasMultiplicativeReductionAt C.E w'
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasMultiplicativeReductionAt_iff_of_stable C.E w (hst w)] at hm
  rw [hasMultiplicativeReductionAt_iff_of_stable C.E w' (hst w')]
  let j₀ : ↥(fieldOfModuli C.F C.E) := ⟨C.E.j, IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ C.E.j⟩
  have key : ∀ w : FinitePlace C.F, FinitePlace.LiesOver w v →
      (w.maximalIdeal.valuation C.F C.E.j ≤ 1 ↔ v.maximalIdeal.valuation _ j₀ ≤ 1) :=
    fun w hw => valuation_algebraMap_le_one_iff hw j₀
  exact fun h => hm ((key w hw).2 ((key w' hw').1 h))

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueChar
statement:
lemma maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueChar {q : ℕ} (hq : q.Prime) (w : FinitePlace C.F)
    (hw : residueChar w = q) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)})
proof:
:= by
  have hmax : (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}).IsMaximal := by
    haveI hprime : (Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)}).IsPrime :=
      (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (by exact_mod_cast hq.ne_zero)).2
        (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hq)
    exact IsPrime.to_maximal_ideal (by
      rw [ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
      exact_mod_cast hq.ne_zero)
  have hmem : (q : ℤ) ∈ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 C.F)) := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, map_natCast]
    exact (natCast_mem_maximalIdeal_iff w hq).2 hw
  refine ⟨hmax.eq_of_le (Ideal.comap_ne_top _ w.maximalIdeal.isPrime.ne_top) ?_⟩
  rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
  exact hmem

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.sum_inertDeg_le
statement:
lemma sum_inertDeg_le (q : ℕ) :
    ∑ w ∈ C.badAll_finite.toFinset.filter (fun w => residueChar w = q), inertDeg C.F w ≤
      Module.finrank ℚ C.F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hq : q.Prime
  · set p : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(q : ℤ)} with hp
    haveI hmax : p.IsMaximal := by
      haveI hprime : p.IsPrime :=
        (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (by exact_mod_cast hq.ne_zero)).2
          (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hq)
      exact IsPrime.to_maximal_ideal (by
        rw [hp, ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
        exact_mod_cast hq.ne_zero)
    have hp0 : p ≠ ⊥ := by
      rw [hp, ne_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
      exact_mod_cast hq.ne_zero
    have hsum := Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia (𝓞 C.F) ℚ C.F hp0 (p := p)
    set T := C.badAll_finite.toFinset.filter (fun w => residueChar w = q) with hT
    
    have hle : ∀ w ∈ T, inertDeg C.F w ≤
        p.ramificationIdx' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal * p.inertiaDeg' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := by
      intro w hw
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_filter] at hw
      haveI := C.maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueChar hq w hw.2
      haveI : w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.IsMaximal :=
        w.maximalIdeal.isPrime.isMaximal w.maximalIdeal.ne_bot
      have he : 0 < p.ramificationIdx' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal :=
        Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver _ hp0)
      calc inertDeg C.F w = p.inertiaDeg' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := by
            rw [inertDeg, Ideal.inertiaDeg'_eq_inertiaDeg p w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal]
        _ ≤ _ := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ he
    have hsub : T.image (fun w : FinitePlace C.F => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) ⊆
        IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset p (𝓞 C.F) := by
      intro P hP
      rw [Finset.mem_image] at hP
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hP
      rw [hT, Finset.mem_filter] at hw
      exact (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hp0 (𝓞 C.F)).mpr
        ⟨inferInstance, C.maximalIdeal_liesOver_of_residueChar hq w hw.2⟩
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun w : FinitePlace C.F => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) T := by
      intro w₁ _ w₂ _ h
      exact FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_injective (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h)
    calc ∑ w ∈ T, inertDeg C.F w
        ≤ ∑ w ∈ T, p.ramificationIdx' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal *
            p.inertiaDeg' w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := Finset.sum_le_sum hle
      _ = ∑ P ∈ T.image (fun w : FinitePlace C.F => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal),
            p.ramificationIdx' P * p.inertiaDeg' P :=
          (Finset.sum_image (f := fun P => p.ramificationIdx' P * p.inertiaDeg' P) hinj).symm
      _ ≤ ∑ P ∈ IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset p (𝓞 C.F),
            p.ramificationIdx' P * p.inertiaDeg' P :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub
      _ = Module.finrank ℚ C.F := hsum
  · refine le_of_eq_of_le (Finset.sum_eq_zero ?_) (Nat.zero_le _)
    intro w hw
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hw
    exact absurd (hw.2 ▸ residueChar_prime w) hq

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.CurveArithmetic.ofCore
statement:
theorem CurveArithmetic.ofCore (h1 : IsSquare (-1 : C.F))
    (h2 : ∀ w : FinitePlace C.F, HasStableReductionAt C.E w)
    (h3 : SixTorsionRational C.F C.E C.Fbar)
    (h4 : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime → 7 ≤ ℓ → IsGaloisOfDegreePrimeTo C.F C.E ℓ) :
    C.CurveArithmetic where
  sqrt_neg_one
proof:
:= h1
  stable_reduction := h2
  six_torsion_rational := h3
  galois_deg_prime := h4
  exists_liesOver := C.exists_liesOver
  residueChar_liesOver := C.residueChar_liesOver
  mult_invariant v _ w w' hw hw' hm := C.mult_invariant h2 v w w' hw hw' hm
  badAll_finite := C.badAll_finite
  inertDeg_pos := C.inertDeg_pos
  sum_inertDeg_le := C.sum_inertDeg_le

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.nsmul_eq_zero_of_mem_of_card_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_nsmul_eq_zero' (x := (⟨P, hP⟩ : H))
  rw [hH] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.le_torsionBy_of_card_eq
proof:
:= fun _ hP =>
  AddSubgroup.torsionBy.nsmul_iff.mpr (nsmul_eq_zero_of_mem_of_card_eq hH hP)

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.HasCyclicSubgroup.exists_le_torsionBy
statement:
lemma HasCyclicSubgroup.exists_le_torsionBy {ℓ : ℕ} (h : C.HasCyclicSubgroup ℓ) :
    ∃ H : AddSubgroup (Affine.Point (Affine.baseChange C.E C.Fbar)),
      Nat.card H = ℓ ∧
      (∀ σ : C.Fbar ≃ₐ[C.F] C.Fbar, ∀ P ∈ H, galPointMap C.F C.E C.Fbar σ P ∈ H) ∧
      H ≤ AddSubgroup.torsionBy (Affine.Point (Affine.baseChange C.E C.Fbar)) ℓ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hH, hgal⟩ := h
  exact ⟨H, hH, hgal, le_torsionBy_of_card_eq hH⟩

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.mem_badAll_of_mem_badPlacesOver
statement:
lemma mem_badAll_of_mem_badPlacesOver {ℓ : ℕ} {w : FinitePlace C.F}
    (hw : w ∈ badPlacesOver C.F C.E (C.VBadOf ℓ)) : w ∈ C.badAll
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hwv⟩ := hw
  exact hv.2.2.2 w hwv

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.TateInputs.qOrder_pos
statement:
lemma TateInputs.qOrder_pos (TI : C.TateInputs) (w : FinitePlace C.F) (hw : w ∈ C.badAll) :
    0 < TI.qOrder w hw
proof:
:=
  ((TI.tate w hw).toOrdered (TI.unif_isUniformizer w hw)).orderNat_pos

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.badPlacesOver_VBadOf
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, ⟨h2, hl, -, hmult⟩, hwv⟩
    refine ⟨hmult w hwv, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [CA.residueChar_liesOver v w hwv] <;> assumption
  · rintro ⟨hm, h2, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hwv⟩ := CA.exists_liesOver w
    have hv2 : residueChar v ≠ 2 := by rwa [← CA.residueChar_liesOver v w hwv]
    refine ⟨v, ⟨hv2, by rwa [← CA.residueChar_liesOver v w hwv], ⟨w, hwv⟩,
      fun w' hw' => CA.mult_invariant v hv2 w w' hwv hw' hm⟩, hwv⟩

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.globalData
statement:
theorem globalData : IsInitialThetaGlobalData C.F C.E C.Fbar (C.VBadOf ℓ) where
  sqrt_neg_one
proof:
:= CA.sqrt_neg_one
  stable_reduction := CA.stable_reduction
  six_torsion_rational := CA.six_torsion_rational
  bad_nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, h2, hl⟩ := hP5
    have hmem : w ∈ badPlacesOver C.F C.E (C.VBadOf ℓ) := by
      rw [C.badPlacesOver_VBadOf CA]
      exact ⟨hw, h2, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  bad_odd v hv := (residueChar_prime v).odd_of_ne_two hv.1
  bad_multiplicative v hv w hwv := hv.2.2.2 w hwv

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.qPilotInputs
statement:
theorem qPilotInputs : QPilotInputs (C.thetaData CA TI hℓ h7 R hsl hP2 hP5 anab hcore) where
  bad_finite
proof:
:= CA.badAll_finite.subset fun _ hw => C.mem_badAll_of_mem_badPlacesOver hw
  inertDeg_pos := CA.inertDeg_pos

name: Iut.EllipticCurveData.logQ_eq
statement:
theorem logQ_eq (LT : LocalTheory.{u, v} (C.thetaData CA TI hℓ h7 R hsl hP2 hP5 anab hcore).Kt)
    (TL : ThetaLocalData (C.thetaData CA TI hℓ h7 R hsl hP2 hP5 anab hcore) LT) :
    (concreteVariantData.{u, v} (C.thetaData CA TI hℓ h7 R hsl hP2 hP5 anab hcore) LT TL
      (C.qPilotInputs CA TI hℓ h7 R hsl hP2 hP5 anab hcore)).qPilot.logQ =
      (C.localHeightData CA TI).heightOther 2 ℓ
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (badPlacesOver C.F C.E (C.VBadOf ℓ)).Finite :=
    CA.badAll_finite.subset fun _ hw => C.mem_badAll_of_mem_badPlacesOver hw
  change ∑ w ∈ hfin.toFinset.attach,
      ((inertDeg C.F w.1 : ℝ) / Module.finrank ℚ C.F) *
        ((TI.qOrder w.1 (C.mem_badAll_of_mem_badPlacesOver (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp w.2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log (residueChar w.1) =
    (∑ w ∈ CA.badAll_finite.toFinset.filter (fun w => residueChar w ≠ 2 ∧ residueChar w ≠ ℓ),
      (((if h : w ∈ C.badAll then TI.qOrder w h else 0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (inertDeg C.F w : ℝ) *
        Real.log (residueChar w))) / Module.finrank ℚ C.F
  have hfinset : hfin.toFinset =
      CA.badAll_finite.toFinset.filter (fun w => residueChar w ≠ 2 ∧ residueChar w ≠ ℓ) := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_filter]
    exact Set.ext_iff.mp (C.badPlacesOver_VBadOf CA) w
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl (g := fun w => ((inertDeg C.F w.1 : ℝ) / Module.finrank ℚ C.F) *
      ((if h : w.1 ∈ C.badAll then TI.qOrder w.1 h else 0 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      Real.log (residueChar w.1)) fun w _ => ?_).trans ?_
  · rw [dif_pos (C.mem_badAll_of_mem_badPlacesOver (hfin.mem_toFinset.mp w.2))]
  · rw [Finset.sum_attach _ (fun w => ((inertDeg C.F w : ℝ) / Module.finrank ℚ C.F) *
      ((if h : w ∈ C.badAll then TI.qOrder w h else 0 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (residueChar w)),
      hfinset]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
    ring

name: Iut.CurveInputs.concreteThetaDataExistence
statement:
theorem concreteThetaDataExistence (anab : AnabelianExistence AG TG)
    (LTp : ∀ D : InitialThetaData AG TG, LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt)
    (TLp : ∀ (D : InitialThetaData AG TG) (LT : LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt), ThetaLocalData D LT)
    (TAp : ∀ (D : InitialThetaData AG TG) (LT : LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt)
      (TL : ThetaLocalData D LT), TowerArithmetic D LT TL) :
    ConcreteThetaDataExistence.{u, v} (AG := AG) (TG := TG) CI.toCorollary22Inputs
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hxe ℓ hℓ h7 hP2 hP3 hP5 hsl
  have hcore : OrbicurveDataSection.HasCoreUniversally AG (CI.curve x hx).F (CI.curve x hx).E := by
    by_contra h
    exact hxe ⟨hx, h⟩
  have hP2' : ∀ w (hw : w ∈ (CI.curve x hx).badAll), ¬ ℓ ∣ (CI.tate x hx).qOrder w hw := by
    intro w hw
    have := hP2 w ((CI.arith x hx).badAll_finite.mem_toFinset.mpr hw)
    change ¬ ℓ ∣ (if h : w ∈ (CI.curve x hx).badAll then (CI.tate x hx).qOrder w h else 0)
      at this
    rwa [dif_pos hw] at this
  have hP5' : ∃ w ∈ (CI.curve x hx).badAll, residueChar w ≠ 2 ∧ residueChar w ≠ ℓ := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, h⟩ := hP5
    exact ⟨w, (CI.arith x hx).badAll_finite.mem_toFinset.mp hw, h⟩
  let D := (CI.curve x hx).thetaData (CI.arith x hx) (CI.tate x hx) hℓ h7 (CI.modRep x hx ℓ hℓ)
    (hsl hx hℓ) hP2' hP5' anab hcore
  refine ⟨D, LTp D, TLp D (LTp D),
    (CI.curve x hx).qPilotInputs (CI.arith x hx) (CI.tate x hx) hℓ h7 (CI.modRep x hx ℓ hℓ)
      (hsl hx hℓ) hP2' hP5' anab hcore,
    TAp _ _ _, rfl, CI.dmod_le x hx, ?_, CI.logDiff_eq x hx, CI.logCond_ge x hx ℓ hℓ h7,
    CI.logCond_le x hx ℓ hℓ h7⟩
  exact (CI.curve x hx).logQ_eq (CI.arith x hx) (CI.tate x hx) hℓ h7 (CI.modRep x hx ℓ hℓ)
    (hsl hx hℓ) hP2' hP5' anab hcore _ _

name: Iut.cor312Variant_implies_abc_curves
statement:
theorem cor312Variant_implies_abc_curves {AG : AnabelianGeometry.{u}} {TG : TemperedGeometry AG}
    (A : T.ProofPackage) (CI : ∀ (K : T.CBS) (d : ℕ), CurveInputs.{u} T AG K d)
    (anab : AnabelianExistence AG TG)
    (LTp : ∀ D : InitialThetaData AG TG, LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt)
    (TLp : ∀ (D : InitialThetaData AG TG) (LT : LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt), ThetaLocalData D LT)
    (TAp : ∀ (D : InitialThetaData AG TG) (LT : LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt)
      (TL : ThetaLocalData D LT), TowerArithmetic D LT TL)
    (cheb : ChebyshevBound) (pnt : PrimeCountingBound)
    (h312 : ∀ (D : InitialThetaData AG TG) (LT : LocalTheory.{u, v} D.Kt)
      (TL : ThetaLocalData D LT) (QI : QPilotInputs D),
      Corollary312Variant (concreteVariantData.{u, v} D LT TL QI)) :
    ABC T
proof:
:=
  cor312Variant_implies_abc_concrete A (fun K d => (CI K d).toCorollary22Inputs)
    (fun K d => (CI K d).concreteThetaDataExistence anab LTp TLp TAp) cheb pnt h312

name: Iut.sum_prod_tuple
statement: lemma sum_prod_tuple : ∑ c : ι → E, ∏ i, w (c i) = (∑ e, w e) ^ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun _ : ι => w)]
  simp

name: Iut.sum_prod_tuple_mul_coord
statement:
lemma sum_prod_tuple_mul_coord (hw : ∑ e, w e = 1) (f : E → ℝ) (i₀ : ι) :
    ∑ c : ι → E, (∏ i, w (c i)) * f (c i₀) = ∑ e, w e * f e
proof:
:= by
  let g : ι → E → ℝ := fun i e => if i = i₀ then w e * f e else w e
  have hg : ∀ c : ι → E, (∏ i, w (c i)) * f (c i₀) = ∏ i, g i (c i) := by
    intro c
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun i => g i (c i)) (Finset.mem_univ i₀),
      ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun i => w (c i)) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)]
    have : ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase i₀, g i (c i) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase i₀, w (c i) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i hi => by simp [g, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1]
    rw [this]
    simp only [g, if_true]
    ring
  simp_rw [hg]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum g,
    ← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ (fun i => ∑ e, g i e) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)]
  have : ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase i₀, ∑ e, g i e = 1 := by
    refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun i hi => ?_
    simp [g, (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1, hw]
  rw [this, mul_one]
  simp [g]

name: Iut.sum_prod_tuple_mul_sum
statement:
lemma sum_prod_tuple_mul_sum (hw : ∑ e, w e = 1) (f : E → ℝ) :
    ∑ c : ι → E, (∏ i, w (c i)) * ∑ i, f (c i) = Fintype.card ι * ∑ e, w e * f e
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp_rw [sum_prod_tuple_mul_coord w hw f]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: Iut.sum_prod_tuple_eq_one
statement:
lemma sum_prod_tuple_eq_one (hw : ∑ e, w e = 1) [inst : Fintype (ι → E)] :
    ∑ c : ι → E, ∏ i, w (c i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Subsingleton.elim inst Pi.instFintype]
  clear inst
  rw [sum_prod_tuple, hw, one_pow]

name: Iut.LocalTheory.differentExponent_nonneg
statement: lemma differentExponent_nonneg (w : FinitePlace D.Kt) : 0 ≤ differentExponent D.Kt w
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)

name: Iut.LocalTheory.logDK_nonneg
statement: lemma logDK_nonneg (p : ℕ) : 0 ≤ LT.logDK p
proof:
:= by
  unfold LocalTheory.logDK
  split_ifs with hp
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun v _ => mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (LT.weight_pos _ v).le (differentExponent_nonneg _))
      (Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt.le))
  · exact le_rfl

name: Iut.ThetaLocalData.dst_prime
statement: lemma dst_prime (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ TL.dst) : p.Prime
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dst, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
    LocalTheory.ramifiedChars, Finset.mem_image, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hp
  rcases hp with ((rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl) | hb) | ⟨w, _, rfl⟩
  · exact Nat.prime_two
  · exact Nat.prime_three
  · exact Nat.prime_five
  · exact D.prime.ℓ_prime
  · exact TL.badChars_prime _ hb
  · exact LT.residueChar_prime w

name: Iut.ThetaLocalData.mem_dst_of_ramified
statement:
lemma mem_dst_of_ramified (w : FinitePlace D.Kt) (hw : ramIdx D.Kt w ≠ 1) :
    residueChar w ∈ TL.dst
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
  simp only [LocalTheory.ramifiedChars, Finset.mem_image, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩

name: Iut.ThetaLocalData.mem_dst_of_badChars
statement: lemma mem_dst_of_badChars (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ TL.badChars) : p ∈ TL.dst
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ hp)

name: Iut.ThetaLocalData.two_mem_dst
statement: lemma two_mem_dst : 2 ∈ TL.dst
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ ?_)
  simp

name: Iut.ThetaLocalData.logDK_eq_zero
statement: lemma logDK_eq_zero (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∉ TL.dst) : LT.logDK p = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold LocalTheory.logDK
  split_ifs with hpp
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun v _ => ?_
    have hunr : ramIdx D.Kt (LT.fiberPlace v) = 1 := by
      by_contra hne
      apply hp
      have := TL.mem_dst_of_ramified _ hne
      rwa [LT.residueChar_fiberPlace] at this
    simp [differentExponent, LT.ordDifferent_eq_zero _ hunr]
  · rfl

name: Iut.logDifferentDeg_nonneg
statement:
lemma logDifferentDeg_nonneg (L : Type*) [Field L] [NumberField L] :
    0 ≤ logDifferentDeg L
proof:
:= by
  apply div_nonneg _ (by positivity)
  apply Real.log_nonneg
  have h : Ideal.absNorm (differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 L)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.absNorm_eq_zero_iff]
    exact differentIdeal_ne_bot
  exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mem_algebraMap_smul_archIntegral
statement:
lemma mem_algebraMap_smul_archIntegral {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) {x : Tensor K .infinite c} :
    x ∈ algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t • archIntegral c ↔ archNorm c x ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraMap_smul_set]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    calc archNorm c (t • y) ≤ |t| * archNorm c y := archNorm_smul_le c t y
      _ ≤ t * 1 := by
          rw [abs_of_pos ht]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy ht.le
      _ = t := mul_one t
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨t⁻¹ • x, ?_, smul_inv_smul₀ ht.ne' x⟩
    change archNorm c (t⁻¹ • x) ≤ 1
    calc archNorm c (t⁻¹ • x) ≤ |t⁻¹| * archNorm c x := archNorm_smul_le c _ x
      _ ≤ t⁻¹ * t := by
          rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr ht)]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (inv_pos.mpr ht).le
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ ht.ne'

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.smul_integralAt_infinite_mono
statement:
theorem smul_integralAt_infinite_mono (t t' : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (htt' : t ≤ t') :
    algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t • integralAt .infinite c ⊆
      algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t' • integralAt .infinite c
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralAt_infinite]
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_algebraMap_smul_archIntegral c (ht.trans_le htt')).mpr
    (((mem_algebraMap_smul_archIntegral c ht).mp hx).trans htt')

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_leastHull_infinite
statement:
theorem exists_leastHull_infinite {U : Set (Tensor K .infinite c)}
    (hU : U ∈ admissible .infinite c) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ U ⊆ algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t • integralAt .infinite c ∧
      ∀ t' : ℝ, 0 < t' →
        U ⊆ algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t' • integralAt .infinite c → t ≤ t'
proof:
:= by
  rw [integralAt_infinite]
  have hbdd : BddAbove (archNorm c '' U) :=
    ((admissible_relCompact hU).image (continuous_archNorm c)).bddAbove.mono
      (Set.image_mono subset_closure)
  have hne : (archNorm c '' U).Nonempty := (admissible_nonempty hU).image _
  have hle : ∀ x ∈ U, archNorm c x ≤ sSup (archNorm c '' U) := fun x hx =>
    le_csSup hbdd ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ sSup (archNorm c '' U) := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := admissible_nonempty hU
    exact (archNorm_nonneg c x).trans (hle x hx)
  have htpos : 0 < sSup (archNorm c '' U) := by
    rcases ht0.lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    exfalso
    have hsub : U ⊆ {0} := by
      intro x hx
      have h0 : archNorm c x = 0 :=
        le_antisymm ((hle x hx).trans h.symm.le) (archNorm_nonneg c x)
      obtain ⟨C, -, hC⟩ := exists_norm_le_archNorm c
      have hx0 : ‖x‖ ≤ 0 := by
        have := hC x
        rwa [h0, mul_zero] at this
      exact norm_le_zero_iff.mp hx0
    haveI : Nontrivial (Tensor K .infinite c) :=
      Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (finrank_tensor_infinite_pos (c := c))
    exact absurd (admissible_haar_pos hU) (not_lt.mpr ((measure_mono hsub).trans
      (measure_singleton (0 : Tensor K .infinite c)).le))
  refine ⟨_, htpos, fun x hx => ?_, fun t' ht' hUt' => ?_⟩
  · exact (mem_algebraMap_smul_archIntegral c htpos).mpr (hle x hx)
  · refine csSup_le hne ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_algebraMap_smul_archIntegral c ht').mp (hUt' hx)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.norm_algHom_apply_subalgebra
statement:
theorem norm_algHom_apply_subalgebra (S : Subalgebra ℝ ℂ)
    (hS : Complex.I ∈ S ∨ ∀ x : S, ∃ r : ℝ, (x : ℂ) = r) (σ : S →ₐ[ℝ] S) (x : S) :
    ‖(σ x : ℂ)‖ = ‖(x : ℂ)‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases hS with hI | hreal
  · set i : S := ⟨Complex.I, hI⟩ with hi
    have hii : i * i = -1 := Subtype.ext (by simp [hi, Complex.I_mul_I])
    have hσi : (σ i : ℂ) ^ 2 = Complex.I ^ 2 := by
      rw [Complex.I_sq, sq, ← Subalgebra.coe_mul, ← map_mul, hii, map_neg, map_one]
      rfl
    have hx : x = algebraMap ℝ S x.1.re + algebraMap ℝ S x.1.im * i := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [hi, Complex.re_add_im]
    rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] at hσi
    conv_lhs => rw [hx, map_add, map_mul, σ.commutes, σ.commutes]
    simp only [Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap,
      Complex.coe_algebraMap]
    rcases hσi with h | h
    · rw [h, Complex.re_add_im]
    · rw [h]
      have : (x.1.re : ℂ) + x.1.im * -Complex.I = conj (x.1 : ℂ) := by
        conv_rhs => rw [← Complex.re_add_im (x.1 : ℂ)]
        simp only [map_add, map_mul, Complex.conj_ofReal, Complex.conj_I, mul_neg]
      rw [this, RCLike.norm_conj]
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hreal x
    have hx : x = algebraMap ℝ S r := Subtype.ext (by simpa using hr)
    rw [hx, σ.commutes]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.archField_cases
statement:
lemma archField_cases (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    Complex.I ∈ archField K w ∨ ∀ x : archField K w, ∃ r : ℝ, (x : ℂ) = r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : w.IsReal
  · right
    intro x
    have hx : (x : ℂ) ∈ (⊥ : Subalgebra ℝ ℂ) := archField_of_isReal K h ▸ x.2
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Algebra.mem_bot.mp hx
    exact ⟨r, hr.symm⟩
  · left
    rw [archField_of_isComplex K (InfinitePlace.not_isReal_iff_isComplex.mp h)]
    exact Algebra.mem_top

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.norm_archAut_apply
statement:
theorem norm_archAut_apply (σ : ArchFactor K v ≃ₐ[ℝ] ArchFactor K v) (x : ArchNormedFactor v) :
    ‖toNormedFactor v (σ x)‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  let σ' : archField K (archPlace K v) →ₐ[ℝ] archField K (archPlace K v) :=
    ULift.algEquiv.toAlgHom.comp (σ.toAlgHom.comp ULift.algEquiv.symm.toAlgHom)
  have h := norm_algHom_apply_subalgebra _ (archField_cases (archPlace K v)) σ' x.down
  exact h

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.norm_archAutCLM_le

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.toArchModel_mapAlgHom
statement:
lemma toArchModel_mapAlgHom (σ : ∀ j, ArchFactor K (c j) ≃ₐ[ℝ] ArchFactor K (c j))
    (x : Tensor K .infinite c) :
    toArchModel c (mapAlgHom .infinite c σ x) =
      PiTensorProduct.mapL (fun j => archAutCLM (c j) (σ j)) (toArchModel c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using PiTensorProduct.induction_on with
  | smul_tprod r m =>
    rw [map_smul, mapAlgHom_tprod]
    change (r • PiTensorProduct.tprod ℝ (fun j => toNormedFactor (c j) (σ j (m j))) :
        ArchModel c) =
      PiTensorProduct.mapL (fun j => archAutCLM (c j) (σ j))
        (r • PiTensorProduct.tprod ℝ (fun j => toNormedFactor (c j) (m j)) : ArchModel c)
    rw [map_smul, PiTensorProduct.mapL_apply, PiTensorProduct.map_tprod]
    rfl
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add]
    change (toArchModel c (mapAlgHom .infinite c σ x) + toArchModel c (mapAlgHom .infinite c σ y) :
        ArchModel c) =
      PiTensorProduct.mapL (fun j => archAutCLM (c j) (σ j))
        (toArchModel c x + toArchModel c y : ArchModel c)
    rw [map_add, hx, hy]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.archNorm_mapAlgHom_le
statement:
theorem archNorm_mapAlgHom_le (σ : ∀ j, ArchFactor K (c j) ≃ₐ[ℝ] ArchFactor K (c j))
    (x : Tensor K .infinite c) : archNorm c (mapAlgHom .infinite c σ x) ≤ archNorm c x
proof:
:= by
  unfold archNorm
  rw [toArchModel_mapAlgHom]
  refine (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) ?_
  refine (PiTensorProduct.opNorm_mapL _).trans ?_
  exact Finset.prod_le_one (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) fun j _ => norm_archAutCLM_le (c j) (σ j)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mapAlgHom_image_archIntegral_subset
statement:

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.indAut_image_smul_archIntegral_subset

    ∀ φ ∈ indAut .infinite c, φ '' (algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t • archIntegral c) ⊆
      algebraMap ℝ (Tensor K .infinite c) t • archIntegral c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩ _ ⟨_, ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨mapAlgHom .infinite c σ x, mapAlgHom_image_archIntegral_subset c σ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  change algebraMap ℝ _ t * mapAlgHom .infinite c σ x =
    mapAlgHom .infinite c σ (algebraMap ℝ _ t * x)

proof:
:= by

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.archNorm_one
statement: lemma archNorm_one : archNorm c 1 ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ j, ‖(1 : ArchNormedFactor (c j))‖ = 1 := by
    intro j
    change ‖(1 : ULift.{u} (archField K (archPlace K (c j))))‖ = 1
    rw [ULift.norm_def, ULift.one_down]
    change ‖((1 : archField K (archPlace K (c j))) : ℂ)‖ = 1
    rw [Subalgebra.coe_one, norm_one]
  have : (1 : Tensor K .infinite c) = PiTensorProduct.tprod ℝ
      (fun j => (1 : ArchNormedFactor (c j))) := rfl
  rw [this]
  refine (archNorm_tprod_le c _).trans ?_
  simp [h1]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_archNorm_le
statement: lemma exists_archNorm_le : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : Tensor K .infinite c, archNorm c x ≤ C * ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  set b := packetBasis .infinite c
  refine ⟨∑ k, archNorm c (b k), Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => archNorm_nonneg c _, fun x => ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← b.sum_equivFun x]
  calc archNorm c (∑ k, b.equivFun x k • b k)
      ≤ ∑ k, archNorm c (b.equivFun x k • b k) := norm_sum_le (E := ArchModel c) _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ k, ‖x‖ * archNorm c (b k) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => ?_
        refine (archNorm_smul_le c _ _).trans ?_
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (archNorm_nonneg c _)
        rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_def]
        exact norm_le_pi_norm _ k
    _ = (∑ k, archNorm c (b k)) * ‖x‖ := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]; simp [mul_comm]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.continuous_archNorm
statement: lemma continuous_archNorm : Continuous (archNorm c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := exists_archNorm_le c
  refine (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (K := ⟨C, hC0⟩) fun x y => ?_).continuous
  rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
  exact (archNorm_sub_le c x y).trans (hC _)

proof:
:=

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.coordLift_eq_coord
statement:
lemma coordLift_eq_coord (k : PacketIndex .infinite c) :
    coordLift c k = (packetBasis .infinite c).coord k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (packetBasis .infinite c).ext fun l => ?_
  rw [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, coordLift_apply]
  have hbl : toArchModel c (packetBasis .infinite c l) =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod ℝ fun j => factorBasis c j (l j) :=
    Basis.piTensorProduct_apply _ l
  rw [hbl, PiTensorProduct.lift.tprod, coordMultilinear_apply]
  simp only [Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases hl : l = k
  · subst hl
    simp
  · rw [if_neg hl]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, l j ≠ k j := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hl (funext h)
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (by rw [if_neg hj])

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.lift_coordMultilinear

lemma lift_coordMultilinear (k : PacketIndex .infinite c) (x : Tensor K .infinite c) :
    PiTensorProduct.lift (coordMultilinear c k).toMultilinearMap (toArchModel c x) =
