proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordLift_apply, coordLift_eq_coord, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.equivFun_apply]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_norm_le_archNorm
statement:
lemma exists_norm_le_archNorm :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x : Tensor K .infinite c, ‖x‖ ≤ C * archNorm c x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨∑ k, ‖coordMultilinear c k‖, Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => norm_nonneg _, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [norm_def, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => norm_nonneg _)
    (archNorm_nonneg c x))]
  intro k
  rw [← lift_coordMultilinear]
  calc ‖PiTensorProduct.lift (coordMultilinear c k).toMultilinearMap (toArchModel c x)‖
      ≤ ‖coordMultilinear c k‖ * ‖toArchModel c x‖ :=
        PiTensorProduct.norm_eval_le_projectiveSeminorm _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ k, ‖coordMultilinear c k‖) * archNorm c x :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
          (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => norm_nonneg (coordMultilinear c k)) (Finset.mem_univ k))
          (archNorm_nonneg c x)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isClosed_archIntegral
statement: lemma isClosed_archIntegral : IsClosed (archIntegral c)
proof:
:=
  isClosed_le (continuous_archNorm c) continuous_const

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_archIntegral_subset_closedBall
statement:
lemma exists_archIntegral_subset_closedBall :
    ∃ M : ℝ, archIntegral c ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := exists_norm_le_archNorm c
  refine ⟨C, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  exact (hC x).trans (mul_le_of_le_one_right hC0 hx)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isBounded_archIntegral
statement: lemma isBounded_archIntegral : Bornology.IsBounded (archIntegral c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_archIntegral_subset_closedBall c
  exact (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨M, hM⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isCompact_archIntegral
statement: lemma isCompact_archIntegral : IsCompact (archIntegral c)
proof:
:=
  (isClosed_archIntegral c).closure_eq ▸ (isBounded_archIntegral c).isCompact_closure

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_ball_subset_archIntegral
statement:
lemma exists_ball_subset_archIntegral :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.ball (0 : Tensor K .infinite c) r ⊆ archIntegral c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := exists_archNorm_le c
  refine ⟨1 / (C + 1), by positivity, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hx
  rw [mem_archIntegral]
  calc archNorm c x ≤ C * ‖x‖ := hC x
    _ ≤ C * (1 / (C + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx.le hC0
    _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [mul_one_div, div_le_one (by positivity)]
        linarith

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.archIntegral_nonempty
statement: lemma archIntegral_nonempty : (archIntegral c).Nonempty
proof: := ⟨1, one_mem_archIntegral c⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.ordp_mul
statement:
lemma ordp_mul (w : FinitePlace K) (x y : completionAt K w) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ordp K w (x * y) = ordp K w x + ordp K w y
proof:
:= by
  unfold ordp
  rw [norm_mul, Real.log_mul (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx) (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy)]
  ring

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.intValuation_residueChar
statement:
lemma intValuation_residueChar (w : FinitePlace K) :
    w.maximalIdeal.intValuation (residueChar w : 𝓞 K) = exp (-(ramIdx K w : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (residueChar w).Prime := residueChar_prime w
  have hp0 : (residueChar w : 𝓞 K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  have hspan : Ideal.span {(residueChar w : 𝓞 K)} ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, Ideal.zero_eq_bot, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
    exact hp0
  have hmap : (Ideal.span {(residueChar w : ℤ)}).map (algebraMap ℤ (𝓞 K)) =
      Ideal.span {(residueChar w : 𝓞 K)} := by
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton, map_natCast]
  haveI := liesOver_span_residueChar w
  have h : (Associates.mk w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal).count
      (Associates.mk (Ideal.span {(residueChar w : 𝓞 K)})).factors = ramIdx K w := by
    rw [Ideal.count_associates_factors_eq hspan w.maximalIdeal.isPrime w.maximalIdeal.ne_bot]
    unfold ramIdx
    rw [Ideal.IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx_eq_normalizedFactors_count
      (Ideal.span {(residueChar w : ℤ)})
      w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal (by rw [hmap]; exact hspan), hmap]
  rw [w.maximalIdeal.intValuation_if_neg hp0, h]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.valued_residueChar
statement:
lemma valued_residueChar (w : FinitePlace K) :
    Valued.v (algebraMap K (completionAt K w) (residueChar w : K)) = exp (-(ramIdx K w : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  have : algebraMap K (completionAt K w) (residueChar w : K) =
      FinitePlace.embedding w.maximalIdeal (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (residueChar w : 𝓞 K)) := by
    rw [map_natCast (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)]
    rfl
  rw [this, FinitePlace.embedding_apply, HeightOneSpectrum.valuedAdicCompletion_eq_valuation',
    HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_of_algebraMap, intValuation_residueChar]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.ordp_p
statement: lemma ordp_p (w : FinitePlace K) : ordp K w (algebraMap K _ (residueChar w : K)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordp_eq_of_valued w _ _ (valued_residueChar w)]
  have he : (ramIdx K w : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ramIdx_pos' w).ne'
  rw [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, neg_neg, div_self he]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.span_prime_ne_bot
statement: lemma span_prime_ne_bot {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
  exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.span_prime_isMaximal
statement: lemma span_prime_isMaximal {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  haveI : (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_prime (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero)).2 (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp)
  exact IsPrime.to_maximal_ideal (span_prime_ne_bot hp)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.liesOver_span_of_residueChar
statement:
lemma liesOver_span_of_residueChar {p : ℕ} (w : FinitePlace K) (hw : residueChar w = p) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hw]
  exact liesOver_span_residueChar w

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.residueChar_eq_of_liesOver_span
statement:
lemma residueChar_eq_of_liesOver_span {p : ℕ} (w : FinitePlace K)
    [h : w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)})] : residueChar w = p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := under_int_eq w
  rw [← Ideal.over_def w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}),
    Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton] at h1
  have h2 := Int.natAbs_eq_iff_associated.mpr h1
  simpa using h2.symm

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.fiber_finite
statement: theorem fiber_finite (p : ℕ) : Finite {w : FinitePlace K // residueChar w = p}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p.Prime
  · have hP0 := span_prime_ne_bot hp
    haveI := span_prime_isMaximal hp
    refine Finite.of_injective (fun w : {w : FinitePlace K // residueChar w = p} =>
      (⟨w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal, ?_⟩ :
        IsDedekindDomain.primesOverFinset (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)}) (𝓞 K))) ?_
    · haveI := liesOver_span_of_residueChar w.1 w.2
      exact (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hP0 (𝓞 K)).mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    · intro w₁ w₂ h
      exact Subtype.ext (FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_injective
        (HeightOneSpectrum.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h)))
  · haveI : IsEmpty {w : FinitePlace K // residueChar w = p} :=
      ⟨fun w => hp (w.2 ▸ residueChar_prime w.1)⟩
    infer_instance

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.sum_localDeg
statement:
theorem sum_localDeg (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [Fintype {w : FinitePlace K // residueChar w = p}] :
    ∑ w : {w : FinitePlace K // residueChar w = p}, localDeg K w.1 = Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : Ideal ℤ := Ideal.span {(p : ℤ)} with hP
  have hP0 : P ≠ ⊥ := span_prime_ne_bot hp
  haveI hmax : P.IsMaximal := span_prime_isMaximal hp
  have hsum := Ideal.sum_ramification_inertia (𝓞 K) ℚ K hP0 (p := P)
  rw [← hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun w _ => w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro w _
    haveI := liesOver_span_of_residueChar w.1 w.2
    exact (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hP0 (𝓞 K)).mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  · intro w₁ _ w₂ _ h
    exact Subtype.ext (FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_injective (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h))
  · intro Q hQ
    obtain ⟨hprime, hover⟩ := (IsDedekindDomain.mem_primesOverFinset_iff hP0 (𝓞 K)).mp hQ
    have hne : Q ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hP0 Q
    refine ⟨⟨FinitePlace.mk ⟨Q, hprime, hne⟩, ?_⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    · haveI : (FinitePlace.mk ⟨Q, hprime, hne⟩).maximalIdeal.asIdeal.LiesOver P := by
        rw [FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk]
        exact hover
      exact residueChar_eq_of_liesOver_span _
    · rw [FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_mk]
  · intro w _
    haveI := liesOver_span_of_residueChar w.1 w.2
    haveI : w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.IsMaximal :=
      w.1.maximalIdeal.isPrime.isMaximal w.1.maximalIdeal.ne_bot
    have hunder : w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.under ℤ = P := by
      rw [under_int_eq, w.2]
    have h1 : ramIdx K w.1 = P.ramificationIdx' w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := by
      have := (Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx _ w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal
        (under_int_ne_bot w.1)).symm
      rwa [hunder] at this
    have h2 : inertDeg K w.1 = P.inertiaDeg' w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal := by
      haveI : (w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.under ℤ).IsMaximal := under_int_isMaximal w.1
      have := (Ideal.inertiaDeg'_eq_inertiaDeg (w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.under ℤ)
        w.1.maximalIdeal.asIdeal).symm
      rwa [hunder] at this
    unfold localDeg
    rw [h1, h2]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.sum_mult
statement: theorem sum_mult : ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, w.mult = Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:=
  InfinitePlace.sum_mult_eq

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isUnramifiedAt_of_ramIdx_eq_one
statement:
lemma isUnramifiedAt_of_ramIdx_eq_one (w : FinitePlace K) (h : ramIdx K w = 1) :
    Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt ℤ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal
proof:
:=
  (Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one_iff (q := w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) (R := ℤ)).mp h

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.ramIdx_eq_one_of_isUnramifiedAt
statement:
lemma ramIdx_eq_one_of_isUnramifiedAt (w : FinitePlace K)
    [Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt ℤ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal] : ramIdx K w = 1
proof:
:=
  Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_one w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ℤ

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.dvd_differentIdeal_of_ramIdx_ne_one
statement:
lemma dvd_differentIdeal_of_ramIdx_ne_one (w : FinitePlace K) (h : ramIdx K w ≠ 1) :
    w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∣ differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dvd_differentIdeal_iff]
  intro hunr
  exact h (ramIdx_eq_one_of_isUnramifiedAt w)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.ramified_finite
statement: theorem ramified_finite : {w : FinitePlace K | ramIdx K w ≠ 1}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hD : differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 K) ≠ ⊥ := differentIdeal_ne_bot
  have hfin : ((UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors (differentIdeal ℤ (𝓞 K))).toFinset :
      Set (Ideal (𝓞 K))).Finite := Finset.finite_toSet _
  refine (hfin.preimage (f := fun w : FinitePlace K => w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) ?_).subset ?_
  · intro w₁ _ w₂ _ h
    exact FinitePlace.maximalIdeal_injective (HeightOneSpectrum.ext h)
  · intro w hw
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset,
      Ideal.mem_normalizedFactors_iff hD]
    exact ⟨inferInstance, Ideal.le_of_dvd (dvd_differentIdeal_of_ramIdx_ne_one w hw)⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.ordDifferent_eq_zero
statement: theorem ordDifferent_eq_zero (w : FinitePlace K) (h : ramIdx K w = 1) : ordDifferent K w = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold ordDifferent
  rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero]
  intro hmem
  have hdvd := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors hmem
  rw [dvd_differentIdeal_iff] at hdvd
  exact hdvd (isUnramifiedAt_of_ramIdx_eq_one w h)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.padic_natCast_ne_zero
statement: lemma padic_natCast_ne_zero : ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mulPadic_apply
statement: lemma mulPadic_apply (x : ℚ_[p]) : mulPadic p x = (p : ℚ_[p]) * x
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mem_padicCoset
statement:
lemma mem_padicCoset {i : Fin p} {x : ℚ_[p]} :
    x ∈ padicCoset p i ↔ ‖x - ((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [padicCoset, Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, neg_add_eq_sub]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.measurableSet_padicCoset
statement: lemma measurableSet_padicCoset (i : Fin p) : MeasurableSet (padicCoset p i)
proof:
:=
  measurableSet_closedBall.preimage (by fun_prop)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.closedBall_eq_iUnion_padicCoset
statement:
lemma closedBall_eq_iUnion_padicCoset :
    Metric.closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) p = ⋃ i : Fin p, padicCoset p i
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  have hpq := padic_natCast_ne_zero p
  ext x
  simp only [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, Set.mem_iUnion, mem_padicCoset]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hpx : ‖(p : ℚ_[p]) * x‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [norm_mul, Padic.norm_p]
      calc (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖x‖ ≤ (p : ℝ)⁻¹ * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx (by positivity)
        _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hp0.ne'
    let z : ℤ_[p] := ⟨(p : ℚ_[p]) * x, hpx⟩
    refine ⟨⟨z.zmodRepr, z.zmodRepr_lt_p⟩, ?_⟩
    have hmem := z.sub_zmodRepr_mem
    rw [PadicInt.maximalIdeal_eq_span_p, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hmem
    have hy' : (p : ℚ_[p]) * x - (z.zmodRepr : ℚ_[p]) = (p : ℚ_[p]) * (y : ℚ_[p]) := by
      have := congrArg (fun w : ℤ_[p] => (w : ℚ_[p])) hy
      simpa [z] using this
    have : x - (z.zmodRepr : ℚ_[p]) / p = (y : ℚ_[p]) := by
      field_simp
      linear_combination hy'
    rw [this]
    exact PadicInt.norm_le_one y
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hi' : ‖((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p‖ ≤ p := by
      rw [norm_div, Padic.norm_p, div_inv_eq_mul]
      have hi1 : ‖((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 := by
        have := PadicInt.norm_le_one ((i : ℕ) : ℤ_[p])
        rwa [PadicInt.norm_def, PadicInt.coe_natCast] at this
      calc ‖((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p])‖ * p ≤ 1 * p := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hi1 hp0.le
        _ = p := one_mul _
    calc ‖x‖ = ‖(x - ((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p) + ((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p‖ := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ max ‖x - ((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p‖ ‖((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p‖ :=
          IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _
      _ ≤ p := max_le (hi.trans (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt.le)) hi'

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.norm_sub_le_max'
statement: lemma norm_sub_le_max' {x y : ℚ_[p]} : ‖x - y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ _).trans_eq (by rw [norm_neg])

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.pairwise_disjoint_padicCoset
statement:
lemma pairwise_disjoint_padicCoset :
    Pairwise fun i j : Fin p => Disjoint (padicCoset p i) (padicCoset p j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxi hxj
  rw [mem_padicCoset] at hxi hxj
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  have hpq := padic_natCast_ne_zero p
  set d : ℤ := ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) with hd
  have h1 : ‖(d : ℚ_[p]) / p‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have : (d : ℚ_[p]) / p = (x - ((j : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p) - (x - ((i : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) / p) := by
      rw [hd]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [this]
    exact (norm_sub_le_max' p).trans (max_le hxj hxi)
  have h2 : ‖(d : ℚ_[p])‖ < 1 := by
    rw [norm_div, Padic.norm_p, div_inv_eq_mul] at h1
    have hinv : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 :=
      inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).one_lt)
    calc ‖(d : ℚ_[p])‖ = ‖(d : ℚ_[p])‖ * p * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel_right₀ hp0.ne' _).symm
      _ ≤ 1 * (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
      _ < 1 := by rwa [one_mul]
  rw [Padic.norm_intCast_lt_one_iff] at h2
  have h3 : d = 0 := by
    refine Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd h2 ?_
    rw [hd, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> omega
  exact hij (Fin.ext (by omega))

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.measure_closedBall_padic
statement:
lemma measure_closedBall_padic (μ : Measure ℚ_[p]) [μ.IsAddLeftInvariant] :
    μ (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) p) = p * μ (Metric.closedBall 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [closedBall_eq_iUnion_padicCoset, measure_iUnion (pairwise_disjoint_padicCoset p)
    (measurableSet_padicCoset p)]
  have : ∀ i : Fin p, μ (padicCoset p i) = μ (Metric.closedBall 0 1) := fun i =>
    measure_preimage_add _ _ _
  simp [this]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.measure_preimage_mul_padic
statement:
theorem measure_preimage_mul_padic (μ : Measure ℚ_[p]) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {s : Set ℚ_[p]}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : μ ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) * x) ⁻¹' s) = p * μ s
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  set f := mulPadic p
  have hf : ⇑f = fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) * x := rfl
  have hmap := Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul (μ.map f) μ
  set c := Measure.addHaarScalarFactor (μ.map f) μ
  have hB : MeasurableSet (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) 1) := measurableSet_closedBall
  have hpre : (fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) * x) ⁻¹' Metric.closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) 1 =
      Metric.closedBall 0 p := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, Padic.norm_p]
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hp0, mul_one]
  have hBpos : μ (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) 1) ≠ 0 :=
    ((IsUltrametricDist.isOpen_closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) one_ne_zero).measure_pos μ
      ⟨0, by simp⟩).ne'
  have hBfin : μ (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) 1) ≠ ⊤ :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).measure_lt_top.ne
  have hc : (c : ENNReal) = p := by
    have h1 := congrArg (fun ν : Measure ℚ_[p] => ν (Metric.closedBall 0 1)) hmap
    simp only [Measure.smul_apply, ENNReal.smul_def] at h1
    rw [Measure.map_apply f.continuous.measurable hB, hf, hpre, measure_closedBall_padic μ] at h1
    exact ((ENNReal.mul_left_inj hBpos hBfin).mp h1).symm
  calc μ ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) * x) ⁻¹' s) = (μ.map f) s := by
        rw [Measure.map_apply f.continuous.measurable hs, hf]
    _ = p * μ s := by rw [hmap, Measure.smul_apply, ENNReal.smul_def, hc, smul_eq_mul]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.pi_measure_preimage_smul_padic
statement:
lemma pi_measure_preimage_smul_padic {n : Type*} [Fintype n] {s : Set (n → ℚ_[p])}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Measure.pi (fun _ : n => (Measure.addHaar : Measure ℚ_[p])) ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' s) =
      (p : ENNReal) ^ Fintype.card n *
        Measure.pi (fun _ : n => (Measure.addHaar : Measure ℚ_[p])) s
proof:
:= by
  set μ₁ : Measure ℚ_[p] := Measure.addHaar
  set π := Measure.pi fun _ : n => μ₁
  have hg : Measurable fun x : n → ℚ_[p] => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x := by fun_prop
  have hpn : ((p : ENNReal) ^ Fintype.card n) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (p : ENNReal) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
    exact pow_ne_zero _ this
  have hpn' : ((p : ENNReal) ^ Fintype.card n) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top p)
  have key : π = ((p : ENNReal) ^ Fintype.card n)⁻¹ • π.map fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x := by
    refine Measure.pi_eq fun t ht => ?_
    rw [Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.map_apply hg (MeasurableSet.pi Set.countable_univ
      fun i _ => ht i)]
    have : (fun x : n → ℚ_[p] => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' Set.pi Set.univ t =
        Set.pi Set.univ fun i => (fun y => (p : ℚ_[p]) * y) ⁻¹' t i := by
      ext x
      simp [Set.mem_pi, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [this, Measure.pi_pi]
    simp only [measure_preimage_mul_padic μ₁ (ht _)]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, ← mul_assoc,
      ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hpn hpn', one_mul]
  calc π ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' s) = (π.map fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) s := by
        rw [Measure.map_apply hg hs]
    _ = (p : ENNReal) ^ Fintype.card n * π s := by
        conv_rhs => rw [key]
        rw [Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hpn hpn', one_mul]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.measure_preimage_smul_padic
proof:
:= by
  haveI : SecondCountableTopology E :=
    (Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] E).equivFunL.toHomeomorph.isInducing.secondCountableTopology
  set e := (Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] E).equivFunL
  set ê := e.toHomeomorph.toMeasurableEquiv
  have hê : ⇑ê = ⇑e := rfl
  set ν := μ.map e
  set π := Measure.pi fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank ℚ_[p] E) => (Measure.addHaar : Measure ℚ_[p])
  set c := Measure.addHaarScalarFactor ν π
  have hν : ν = c • π := Measure.isAddLeftInvariant_eq_smul ν π
  have hmap : ∀ t : Set E, μ t = ν (e '' t) := by
    intro t
    have : μ t = (μ.map ê) (ê '' t) := by
      rw [MeasurableEquiv.map_apply, ê.injective.preimage_image]
    rw [this]
    rfl
  have himage : e '' ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' s) =
      (fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' (e '' s) := by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(p : ℚ_[p]) • x, hx, by rw [map_smul]⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
      refine ⟨e.symm y, ?_, e.apply_symm_apply y⟩
      have : (p : ℚ_[p]) • e.symm y = x := by
        apply e.injective
        rw [map_smul, e.apply_symm_apply, hxy]
      rw [this]
      exact hx
  have hs' : MeasurableSet (e '' s) := ê.measurableSet_image.mpr hs
  calc μ ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' s)
      = ν (e '' ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' s)) := hmap _
    _ = ν ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' (e '' s)) := by rw [himage]
    _ = c • π ((fun x => (p : ℚ_[p]) • x) ⁻¹' (e '' s)) := by rw [hν, Measure.smul_apply]
    _ = c • ((p : ENNReal) ^ Module.finrank ℚ_[p] E * π (e '' s)) := by
        rw [pi_measure_preimage_smul_padic hs', Fintype.card_fin]
    _ = (p : ENNReal) ^ Module.finrank ℚ_[p] E * (c • π (e '' s)) := by
        simp only [ENNReal.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
    _ = (p : ENNReal) ^ Module.finrank ℚ_[p] E * ν (e '' s) := by rw [hν, Measure.smul_apply]
    _ = (p : ENNReal) ^ Module.finrank ℚ_[p] E * μ s := by rw [hmap s]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.haar_submodule_eq_zero
statement:
theorem haar_submodule_eq_zero (S : Submodule ℚ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) (hS : S ≠ ⊤) :
    haar (.finite p) c (S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x ∉ S := by
    simpa only [Submodule.eq_top_iff', not_exists, Ne, not_forall] using hS
  set u : ℕ → Tensor K (.finite p) c := fun n => ((n : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) • x with hu_def
  have hu : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range u) := by
    refine isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr ⟨‖x‖, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [hu_def, norm_smul]
    refine mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) ?_
    exact_mod_cast Padic.norm_int_le_one (n : ℤ)
  have hmeas : MeasurableSet (S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) :=
    (Submodule.closed_of_finiteDimensional S).measurableSet
  have hdisj : Pairwise (Disjoint on fun n => {u n} + (S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c))) := by
    intro n k hnk
    simp only [Function.onFun, Set.singleton_add, Set.image_add_left, Set.disjoint_left,
      Set.mem_preimage, SetLike.mem_coe]
    intro y hyn hyk
    have hmem : ((k : ℚ_[p]) - n) • x ∈ S := by
      have := S.sub_mem hyn hyk
      rw [neg_add_eq_sub, neg_add_eq_sub, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left] at this
      change (k : ℚ_[p]) • x - (n : ℚ_[p]) • x ∈ S at this
      rwa [← sub_smul] at this
    have hne : ((k : ℚ_[p]) - n) ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.cast_injective.ne hnk.symm)
    apply hx
    have := S.smul_mem ((k : ℚ_[p]) - n)⁻¹ hmem
    rwa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, one_smul] at this
  have key : ∀ R : ℝ, haar (.finite p) c
      ((S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R) = 0 := by
    intro R
    set s := (S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 R with hs
    have hsb : Bornology.IsBounded s := Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset Set.inter_subset_right
    have hsm : MeasurableSet s := hmeas.inter Metric.isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet
    have hdisj' : Pairwise (Disjoint on fun n => {u n} + s) :=
      pairwise_disjoint_mono hdisj fun n => Set.add_subset_add subset_rfl Set.inter_subset_left
    by_contra h
    apply lt_irrefl (⊤ : ENNReal)
    calc (⊤ : ENNReal) = ∑' _ : ℕ, haar (.finite p) c s :=
          (ENNReal.tsum_const_eq_top_of_ne_zero h).symm
      _ = ∑' n : ℕ, haar (.finite p) c ({u n} + s) := by
          congr 1
          ext1 n
          simp only [Set.image_add_left, measure_preimage_add, Set.singleton_add]
      _ = haar (.finite p) c (⋃ n, {u n} + s) :=
          Eq.symm <| measure_iUnion hdisj' fun n => by
            have hm : Measurable fun y : Tensor K (.finite p) c => -u n + y :=
              (continuous_const.add continuous_id).measurable
            simpa only [Set.image_add_left, Set.singleton_add] using hm hsm
      _ = haar (.finite p) c (Set.range u + s) := by
          rw [← Set.iUnion_add, Set.iUnion_singleton_eq_range]
      _ < ⊤ := (hu.add hsb).measure_lt_top
  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
  calc haar (.finite p) c (S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c))
      ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, haar (.finite p) c
          ((S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 n) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← Metric.iUnion_inter_closedBall_nat (S : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) 0]
        exact measure_iUnion_le _
    _ = 0 := by simp only [key, tsum_zero]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_proj_ne_zero_of_haar_pos
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hsub : U ⊆ (m.asIdeal.restrictScalars ℚ_[p] : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) := by
    intro x hx
    have := h x hx
    rwa [proj_apply, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at this
  have hne : m.asIdeal.restrictScalars ℚ_[p] ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    have h1 : (1 : Tensor K (.finite p) c) ∈ m.asIdeal := Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mp htop 1
    exact m.isMaximal.ne_top ((Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mpr h1)
  exact absurd hU (not_lt.mpr ((measure_mono hsub).trans
    (haar_submodule_eq_zero p c _ hne).le))

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_forall_resNorm_proj_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hU.subset_closedBall 0
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := exists_closedBall_subset_integral p c
  have hp1 : ‖((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p])‖ < 1 := by
    rw [Padic.norm_p]
    exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : (p : ℕ).Prime).one_lt)
  have hp0 : 0 < ‖((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p])‖ :=
    norm_pos_iff.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : (p : ℕ).Prime).ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (show 0 < r / (|R| + 1) by positivity) hp1
  set q : ℚ_[p] := ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ n with hq
  have hq0 : 0 < ‖q‖ := by rw [hq, norm_pow]; exact pow_pos hp0 n
  refine ⟨‖q‖⁻¹, fun x hx m => ?_⟩
  have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ |R| + 1 := by
    have := hR hx
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this
    exact this.trans ((le_abs_self R).trans (by linarith))
  have hmem : q • x ∈ integral p c := by
    refine hsub ?_
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_smul, hq, norm_pow]
    calc ‖((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p])‖ ^ n * ‖x‖ ≤ r / (|R| + 1) * (|R| + 1) :=
          mul_le_mul hn.le hxR (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = r := div_mul_cancel₀ r (by positivity)
  have := mem_integral_iff_forall_resNorm_le_one.mp hmem m
  rw [map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, resNorm_mul, resNorm_algebraMap] at this
  calc resNorm p c m (proj p c m x) = ‖q‖⁻¹ * (‖q‖ * resNorm p c m (proj p c m x)) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq0.ne', one_mul]
    _ ≤ ‖q‖⁻¹ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (inv_nonneg.mpr hq0.le)
    _ = ‖q‖⁻¹ := mul_one _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_leastHull_finite
statement:
theorem exists_leastHull_finite {U : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)}
    (hU : U ∈ admissible (.finite p) c) :
    ∃ a : Tensor K (.finite p) c, IsUnit a ∧ U ⊆ a • integral p c ∧
      ∀ b : Tensor K (.finite p) c, IsUnit b → U ⊆ b • integral p c →
        a • integral p c ⊆ b • integral p c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne := admissible_nonempty hU
  have hbdd : Bornology.IsBounded U :=
    (admissible_relCompact hU).isBounded.subset subset_closure
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_forall_resNorm_proj_le p c hbdd
  set M : ∀ m : MaximalSpectrum (Tensor K (.finite p) c), ℝ :=
    fun m => sSup ((fun x => resNorm p c m (proj p c m x)) '' U) with hM
  have hMbdd : ∀ m, BddAbove ((fun x => resNorm p c m (proj p c m x)) '' U) := fun m =>
    ⟨B, by rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact hB x hx m⟩
  have hMle : ∀ m, ∀ x ∈ U, resNorm p c m (proj p c m x) ≤ M m := fun m x hx =>
    le_csSup (hMbdd m) ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hMpos : ∀ m, 0 < M m := fun m => by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx0⟩ := exists_proj_ne_zero_of_haar_pos p c (admissible_haar_pos hU) m
    exact (resNorm_pos hx0).trans_le (hMle m x hx)
  have hMsup : ∀ m (t : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ U, resNorm p c m (proj p c m x) ≤ t) → M m ≤ t :=
    fun m t ht => csSup_le (hne.image _) (by rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; exact ht x hx)
  choose b hb0 hbM hbmin using fun m => exists_least_resNorm_ge (p := p) (c := c) (m := m)
    (hMpos m)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_forall_proj_eq p c b
  have haU : IsUnit a := isUnit_iff_forall_proj_ne_zero.mpr fun m => (ha m).symm ▸ hb0 m
  refine ⟨a, haU, fun x hx => ?_, fun b' hb' hUb' => ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_smul_integral_iff haU]
    intro m
    rw [ha m]
    exact (hMle m x hx).trans (hbM m)
  · intro x hx
    rw [mem_smul_integral_iff haU] at hx
    rw [mem_smul_integral_iff hb']
    intro m
    refine (hx m).trans ?_
    rw [ha m]
    refine hbmin m _ (isUnit_iff_forall_proj_ne_zero.mp hb' m) (hMsup m _ fun y hy => ?_)
    exact (mem_smul_integral_iff hb').mp (hUb' hy) m

proof:

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mapAlgHom_image_span_subset
statement:
theorem mapAlgHom_image_span_subset
    (σ : ∀ j, Factor K p (c j) ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]] Factor K p (c j))
    (S : ∀ j, Set (Factor K p (c j))) (hσ : ∀ j, σ j '' S j ⊆ S j) :
    mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ ''
        (Submodule.span ℤ_[p] (Set.range fun a : ∀ j, S j =>
          PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p] fun j => (a j : Factor K p (c j))) :
            Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ⊆
      Submodule.span ℤ_[p] (Set.range fun a : ∀ j, S j =>
          PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p] fun j => (a j : Factor K p (c j)))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [mapAlgHom_tprod]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨fun j => ⟨σ j (a j), hσ j ⟨_, (a j).2, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ ((r : ℚ_[p]) • x) ∈ _
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mapAlgHom_image_order_subset
statement:
theorem mapAlgHom_image_order_subset
    (σ : ∀ j, Factor K p (c j) ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]] Factor K p (c j))
    (hσ : ∀ j (a : completionAt K (finPart K (c j))), ‖a‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∃ b : completionAt K (finPart K (c j)),
        ‖b‖ ≤ 1 ∧ σ j (factorMk p (c j) a) = factorMk p (c j) b) :
    mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ '' order p c ⊆ order p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_order] at hx ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    unfold tprodIntegral
    rw [mapAlgHom_tprod]
    choose b hb hb' using fun j => hσ j (a j).1 (a j).2
    have : (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p] fun j => σ j (factorMk p (c j) (a j).1)) =
        tprodIntegral p c fun j => ⟨b j, hb j⟩ := by
      unfold tprodIntegral
      exact congrArg _ (funext fun j => hb' j)
    rw [this]
    exact tprodIntegral_mem p c _
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ ((r : ℚ_[p]) • x) ∈ _
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.norm_le_one_of_ordp_nonneg
statement:
lemma norm_le_one_of_ordp_nonneg {w : FinitePlace K} {x : completionAt K w}
    (h : 0 ≤ ordp K w x) : ‖x‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) < residueChar w := by exact_mod_cast (residueChar_prime w).one_lt
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (residueChar w) := Real.log_pos hp
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < localDeg K w := by exact_mod_cast localDeg_pos w
  unfold ordp at h
  have h' : 0 ≤ -Real.log ‖x‖ := by
    have := mul_nonneg h (mul_pos hn hlog).le
    rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (mul_pos hn hlog).ne'] at this
  exact (Real.log_nonpos_iff (norm_nonneg x)).mp (by linarith)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_isCompact_closedBall_subset
statement:
theorem exists_isCompact_closedBall_subset :
    ∃ C : Set (completionAt K w), IsCompact C ∧ Metric.closedBall (0 : completionAt K w) 1 ⊆ C
proof:
:= by
  letI := padicAlgebra hw
  haveI : ContinuousSMul ℚ_[p] (completionAt K w) :=
    continuousSMul_of_algebraMap ℚ_[p] _ (continuous_padicEmb hw)
  haveI := finite_padicAlgebra hw
  haveI : IsModuleTopology ℚ_[p] (completionAt K w) := isModuleTopologyOfFiniteDimensional
  let b := Module.finBasis ℚ K
  let φ : (Fin (Module.finrank ℚ K) → ℚ_[p]) →ₗ[ℚ_[p]] completionAt K w :=
    Fintype.linearCombination ℚ_[p] fun i => ((b i : K) : completionAt K w)
  have hφ : Function.Surjective φ := by
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, Fintype.range_linearCombination]
    exact span_range_finBasis_eq_top hw
  set B : Set (Fin (Module.finrank ℚ K) → ℚ_[p]) := Set.pi Set.univ fun _ => Metric.closedBall 0 1
    with hB
  have hBopen : IsOpen B :=
    isOpen_set_pi Set.finite_univ fun _ _ => IsUltrametricDist.isOpen_closedBall _ one_ne_zero
  have hBcompact : IsCompact B := isCompact_univ_pi fun _ => isCompact_closedBall _ _
  have hΛopen : IsOpen (φ '' B) := IsModuleTopology.isOpenMap_of_surjective hφ _ hBopen
  have hΛcompact : IsCompact (φ '' B) :=
    hBcompact.image (IsModuleTopology.continuous_of_linearMap φ)
  have h0 : φ '' B ∈ nhds (0 : completionAt K w) :=
    hΛopen.mem_nhds ⟨0, fun _ _ => by simp, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp h0
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hε (norm_natCast_prime_lt_one hw)
  have hp0 : ((p : K) : completionAt K w) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (p : K) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_zero
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ (FinitePlace.embedding w.maximalIdeal).injective).mpr this
  refine ⟨(fun y => (((p : K) : completionAt K w) ^ r)⁻¹ * y) '' (φ '' B),
    hΛcompact.image (by fun_prop), fun x hx => ?_⟩
  refine ⟨((p : K) : completionAt K w) ^ r * x, hball ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_mul, norm_pow]
    calc ‖((p : K) : completionAt K w)‖ ^ r * ‖x‖
        ≤ ‖((p : K) : completionAt K w)‖ ^ r * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa using hx) (by positivity)
      _ < ε := by simpa using hr
  · dsimp only
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hp0), one_mul]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_factor_coord_bound
statement:
theorem exists_factor_coord_bound : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ a : completionAt K (finPart K v), ‖a‖ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ k, ‖(Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)).repr (factorMk p v a) k‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOver K p v
  · letI := padicAlgebra h.residueChar_finPart
    haveI : ContinuousSMul ℚ_[p] (completionAt K (finPart K v)) :=
      continuousSMul_of_algebraMap ℚ_[p] _ (continuous_padicEmb h.residueChar_finPart)
    haveI := finite_padicAlgebra h.residueChar_finPart
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hsub⟩ := exists_isCompact_closedBall_subset h.residueChar_finPart
    let g : completionAt K (finPart K v) →ₗ[ℚ_[p]]
        (Fin (Module.finrank ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)) → ℚ_[p]) :=
      (Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)).equivFun.toLinearMap ∘ₗ factorMkₗ p v h
    have hg : Continuous g := LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional g
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hg.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max M 0, le_max_right _ _, fun a ha k => ?_⟩
    have hga : ‖g a‖ ≤ M := hM a (hsub (by simpa using ha))
    calc ‖(Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)).repr (factorMk p v a) k‖
        = ‖g a k‖ := by
          simp only [g, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Module.Basis.equivFun_apply]
          rfl
      _ ≤ ‖g a‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ _
      _ ≤ max M 0 := hga.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · refine ⟨0, le_rfl, fun a _ k => ?_⟩
    haveI := subsingleton_factor p v h
    have : Module.finrank ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v) = 0 := Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
    exact absurd k.2 (by omega)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.algebraMap_padicInt_apply
statement:
lemma algebraMap_padicInt_apply (r : ℤ_[p]) :
    algebraMap ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c) r = algebraMap ℚ_[p] _ (r : ℚ_[p])
proof: := rfl

statement:
lemma padicInt_smul_def (r : ℤ_[p]) (x : Tensor K (.finite p) c) :

proof: := rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mem_order
statement: lemma mem_order {x : Tensor K (.finite p) c} : x ∈ order p c ↔ x ∈ orderSubmodule p c
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.integralSet_subset_order
statement: lemma integralSet_subset_order : integralSet p c ⊆ order p c
proof: := Submodule.subset_span

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.tprodIntegral_mem
statement: lemma tprodIntegral_mem (a : IntegralTuple c) : tprodIntegral p c a ∈ order p c
proof:
:=
  integralSet_subset_order p c ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.one_mem_order
statement: lemma one_mem_order : (1 : Tensor K (.finite p) c) ∈ order p c
proof:
:= by
  have : (1 : Tensor K (.finite p) c) = tprodIntegral p c fun _ => ⟨1, by simp⟩ := by
    rw [PiTensorProduct.one_def]
    unfold tprodIntegral
    refine congrArg (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p]) ?_
    funext j
    exact (map_one _).symm
  rw [this]
  exact tprodIntegral_mem p c _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.tprodIntegral_mul
statement:
lemma tprodIntegral_mul (a b : IntegralTuple c) :
    tprodIntegral p c a * tprodIntegral p c b =
      tprodIntegral p c fun j => ⟨(a j).1 * (b j).1, by
        rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_one₀ (a j).2 (norm_nonneg _) (b j).2⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold tprodIntegral
  rw [PiTensorProduct.tprod_mul_tprod]
  refine congrArg (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p]) ?_
  funext j
  exact (map_mul (factorMk p (c j)) _ _).symm

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mul_mem_order
statement:
lemma mul_mem_order {x y : Tensor K (.finite p) c} (hx : x ∈ order p c)
    (hy : y ∈ order p c) : x * y ∈ order p c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_order] at hx hy ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [tprodIntegral_mul]
      exact tprodIntegral_mem p c _
    | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hy hz
    | smul r y _ hy =>
      change tprodIntegral p c a * ((r : ℚ_[p]) • y) ∈ _
      rw [mul_smul_comm]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hy
  | zero => rw [zero_mul]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x z _ _ hx hz => rw [add_mul]; exact add_mem hx hz
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change ((r : ℚ_[p]) • x) * y ∈ _
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.incl_mem_order
statement:
lemma incl_mem_order (j : ι) (w : FinitePlace K) (h : c j = Place.finite w)
    (x : completionAt K w) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : incl p c j w h x ∈ order p c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set x' := completionCongr (eq_finPart h) x with hx'
  have hx'norm : ‖x'‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hx', norm_completionCongr]
    exact hx
  let a : IntegralTuple c := fun i =>
    ⟨Function.update (fun i => (1 : completionAt K (finPart K (c i)))) j x' i, by
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst hij
        rw [Function.update_self]
        exact hx'norm
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hij]
        simp⟩
  have : incl p c j w h x = tprodIntegral p c a := by
    rw [incl_apply]
    unfold inclFactor tprodIntegral
    rw [PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom_apply]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp [a, MonoidHom.mulSingle_apply, hx']
    · simp [a, MonoidHom.mulSingle_apply, hij]
  rw [this]
  exact tprodIntegral_mem p c a

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.smul_order_subset
statement:
lemma smul_order_subset (j : ι) (w : FinitePlace K) (h : c j = Place.finite w)
    (x : completionAt K w) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : incl p c j w h x • order p c ⊆ order p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact mul_mem_order p c (incl_mem_order p c j w h x hx) hy

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.smul_order_subset_of_ordp
statement:
lemma smul_order_subset_of_ordp (j : ι) (w : FinitePlace K) (h : c j = Place.finite w)
    (x : completionAt K w) (_hx : x ≠ 0) (hord : 0 ≤ ordp K w x) :
    incl p c j w h x • order p c ⊆ order p c
proof:
:=
  smul_order_subset p c j w h x (norm_le_one_of_ordp_nonneg hord)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_norm_tprodIntegral_le
statement:
lemma exists_norm_tprodIntegral_le :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ a : IntegralTuple c, ‖tprodIntegral p c a‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  choose C hC0 hC using fun j => exists_factor_coord_bound p (c j)
  refine ⟨∏ j, C j, Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hC0 j, fun a => ?_⟩
  rw [norm_def, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hC0 j)]
  intro k
  rw [Module.Basis.equivFun_apply]
  unfold packetBasis tprodIntegral
  rw [Basis.piTensorProduct_repr_tprod_apply, norm_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) fun j _ => hC j _ (a j).2 _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_order_subset_closedBall
statement:
lemma exists_order_subset_closedBall :
    ∃ M : ℝ, order p c ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ := exists_norm_tprodIntegral_le p c
  refine ⟨M, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  rw [mem_order] at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hM a
  | zero => simpa using hM0
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max x y).trans (max_le hx hy)
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change ‖(r : ℚ_[p]) • x‖ ≤ M
    rw [norm_smul]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (PadicInt.norm_le_one r)).trans hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isBounded_order
statement: lemma isBounded_order : Bornology.IsBounded (order p c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_order_subset_closedBall p c
  exact (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨M, hM⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isCompact_closure_order
statement: lemma isCompact_closure_order : IsCompact (closure (order p c))
proof:
:=
  (isBounded_order p c).isCompact_closure

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_pow_smul_finBasis_mem
statement:
lemma exists_pow_smul_finBasis_mem (v : Place K) : ∃ m : ℕ,
    ∀ k, ∃ y : completionAt K (finPart K v), ‖y‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      factorMk p v y = ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ m • Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v) k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOver K p v
  · have hw := h.residueChar_finPart
    have hp1 := norm_natCast_prime_lt_one hw
    have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ‖(((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v))‖ := norm_nonneg _
    choose y hy using fun k => factorMk_surjective p v (Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v) k)
    have hm : ∀ k, ∃ m : ℕ, ‖(((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v))‖ ^ m * ‖y k‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro k
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (‖y k‖ + 1) by positivity) hp1
      refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
      calc ‖(((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v))‖ ^ m * ‖y k‖
          ≤ 1 / (‖y k‖ + 1) * ‖y k‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm.le (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, one_mul, div_le_one (by positivity)]
          linarith
    choose m hm using hm
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup m, fun k => ⟨(((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v)) ^
      Finset.univ.sup m * y k, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
      calc ‖(((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v))‖ ^ Finset.univ.sup m * ‖y k‖
          ≤ ‖(((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v))‖ ^ m k * ‖y k‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
              (pow_le_pow_of_le_one hp0 hp1.le (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ k))) (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ 1 := hm k
    · have hpe : padicEmb hw ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) =
          (((p : ℕ) : K) : completionAt K (finPart K v)) := by
        rw [← Rat.cast_natCast, padicEmb_ratCast, Rat.cast_natCast]
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, algebraMap_factor_apply_of_isOver p v h, map_pow, hpe, ← hy k,
        ← map_mul]
  · refine ⟨0, fun k => ?_⟩
    haveI := subsingleton_factor p v h
    have : Module.finrank ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v) = 0 := Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
    exact absurd k.2 (by omega)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_pow_smul_packetBasis_mem
statement:
lemma exists_pow_smul_packetBasis_mem : ∃ M : ℕ, ∀ k : PacketIndex (.finite p) c,
    ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M • packetBasis (.finite p) c k ∈ order p c
proof:
:= by
  choose m hm using fun j => exists_pow_smul_finBasis_mem p (c j)
  refine ⟨∑ j, m j, fun k => ?_⟩
  choose y hy hy' using fun j => hm j (k j)
  have : ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ (∑ j, m j) • packetBasis (.finite p) c k =
      tprodIntegral p c fun j => ⟨y j, hy j⟩ := by
    unfold packetBasis tprodIntegral
    rw [Basis.piTensorProduct_apply, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact (hy' j).symm
  rw [this]
  exact tprodIntegral_mem p c _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_closedBall_subset_order
statement:
lemma exists_closedBall_subset_order :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.closedBall (0 : Tensor K (.finite p) c) r ⊆ order p c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_pow_smul_packetBasis_mem p c
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < ‖((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M‖ := by
    rw [norm_pow, Padic.norm_p]
    have : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : (p : ℕ).Prime).one_lt
    positivity
  refine ⟨_, hp, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, norm_def, pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hp.le] at hx
  have hpM : ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M ≠ 0 := by
    have : ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : (p : ℕ).Prime).ne_zero
    exact pow_ne_zero _ this
  rw [← (packetBasis (.finite p) c).sum_equivFun x, mem_order]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
  have hk : ‖(packetBasis (.finite p) c).equivFun x k / ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [norm_div, div_le_one hp]
    exact hx k
  let r : ℤ_[p] := ⟨_, hk⟩
  have : (packetBasis (.finite p) c).equivFun x k • packetBasis (.finite p) c k =
      r • (((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M • packetBasis (.finite p) c k) := by
    change _ = ((packetBasis (.finite p) c).equivFun x k / ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M) •
      (((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ M • packetBasis (.finite p) c k)
    rw [smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hpM]
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r (hM k)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.coe_orderAddSubgroup
statement:
lemma coe_orderAddSubgroup : (orderAddSubgroup p c : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) =

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isOpen_order

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := exists_closedBall_subset_order p c
  rw [← coe_orderAddSubgroup]
  exact AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds _
    (Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds 0 hr) hsub)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isClosed_order

  exact AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen _ (isOpen_order p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isCompact_order

:=
  (isClosed_order p c).closure_eq ▸ isCompact_closure_order p c

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.order_nonempty
statement: lemma order_nonempty : (order p c).Nonempty
proof: := ⟨1, one_mem_order p c⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.subsingleton_tensor_of_not_isOver
statement:
lemma subsingleton_tensor_of_not_isOver (j : ι) (h : ¬ IsOver K p (c j)) :
    Subsingleton (Tensor K (.finite p) c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI := subsingleton_factor p (c j) h
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
  have hzero : ∀ z : Tensor K (.finite p) c, z = 0 := by
    intro z
    induction z using PiTensorProduct.induction_on with
    | smul_tprod r f =>
      have hf : f = Function.update f j 0 := by
        funext i
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          rw [Function.update_self]
          exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hij]
      rw [hf, MultilinearMap.map_update_zero, smul_zero]
    | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]
  rw [hzero x, hzero y]

name: Iut.norm_lt_one_iff_tendsto_pow
statement:
theorem norm_lt_one_iff_tendsto_pow {F : Type*} [NormedField F] (a : F) :
    ‖a‖ < 1 ↔ Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => a ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_norm_lt_one, fun h => ?_⟩
  by_contra hle
  push Not at hle
  rw [NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero] at h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (h 1 one_pos).exists
  rw [norm_pow] at hn
  exact absurd hn (not_lt.mpr (one_le_pow₀ hle))

name: Iut.norm_map_sub_one_lt
statement:
theorem norm_map_sub_one_lt (τ : k →+* k) (hτ : Continuous τ) {u : k} (hu : ‖u - 1‖ < 1) :
    ‖τ u - 1‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_lt_one_iff_tendsto_pow] at hu ⊢
  have h := (hτ.tendsto 0).comp hu
  rw [map_zero] at h
  refine h.congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_pow, map_sub, map_one]

name: Iut.zero_mem_logShell
statement: theorem zero_mem_logShell {p : ℕ} : (0 : k) ∈ logShell k p
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, by simp, by simp⟩

name: Iut.map_padicLog
statement:
theorem map_padicLog (hp : p.Prime) (hpk : ‖(p : k)‖ < 1) (τ : k →+* k) (hτ : Continuous τ)
    {u : k} (hu : ‖u - 1‖ < 1) : τ (padicLog u) = padicLog (τ u)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasSum_padicLog hp hpk hu).map τ hτ
  have hterm : (⇑τ ∘ logTerm u) = logTerm (τ u) := by
    funext n
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, logTerm, map_div₀, map_mul, map_pow, map_neg, map_one,
      map_sub, map_add, map_natCast]
  rw [hterm] at h
  exact h.tsum_eq.symm

name: Iut.RingHom.image_logShell_subset
statement:
theorem RingHom.image_logShell_subset (hp : p.Prime) (hpk : ‖(p : k)‖ < 1) (τ : k →+* k)
    (hτ : Continuous τ) : τ '' logShell k p ⊆ logShell k p
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨τ u, norm_map_sub_one_lt τ hτ hu, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, map_inv₀, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_natCast, map_padicLog hp hpk τ hτ hu]

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.norm_natCast_lt_one_completion
statement:
lemma norm_natCast_lt_one_completion {p : Nat.Primes} {w : FinitePlace K}
    (hw : residueChar w = p) : ‖((p : ℕ) : completionAt K w)‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  have := norm_natCast_prime_lt_one (p := (p : ℕ)) (w := w) hw
  rwa [← FinitePlace.embedding_apply, map_natCast] at this

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mem_factorLogShell
statement:
lemma mem_factorLogShell {b : Factor K p v} :
    b ∈ factorLogShell p v ↔
      ∃ y ∈ Iut.logShell (completionAt K (finPart K v)) p, factorMk p v y = b
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.factorMk_mem_factorLogShell_of_norm_le_one
statement:
lemma factorMk_mem_factorLogShell_of_norm_le_one (a : completionAt K (finPart K v))
    (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) : factorMk p v a ∈ factorLogShell p v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOver K p v
  · exact ⟨a, closedBall_subset_logShell p.2 (norm_natCast_lt_one_completion h.residueChar_finPart)
      (by simpa using ha), rfl⟩
  · haveI := subsingleton_factor p v h
    exact ⟨0, zero_mem_logShell, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.factorLogShell_eq_of_unramified
statement:
lemma factorLogShell_eq_of_unramified (hodd : Odd (p : ℕ))
    (hunr : ∀ w, v = Place.finite w → ramIdx K w = 1) :
    factorLogShell p v = factorMk p v '' Metric.closedBall 0 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOver K p v
  · have hw := h.residueChar_finPart
    have hpk := norm_natCast_lt_one_completion hw
    unfold factorLogShell
    rw [logShell_eq_closedBall p.2 hpk hodd]
    intro a ha
    
    obtain ⟨w', hw', -⟩ := h
    have he : ramIdx K (finPart K v) = 1 := by
      rw [hw', finPart_finite]
      exact hunr w' hw'
    have hvp : Valued.v ((p : ℕ) : completionAt K (finPart K v)) = WithZero.exp (-1 : ℤ) := by
      have := valued_residueChar (finPart K v)
      rw [he, hw, Nat.cast_one] at this
      rwa [map_natCast] at this
    rw [Valued.toNormedField.norm_le_iff, hvp]
    rw [Valued.toNormedField.norm_lt_one_iff] at ha
    rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha0
    · rw [map_zero]; exact zero_le
    · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m : ℤ, Valued.v a = WithZero.exp m :=
        ⟨_, (WithZero.exp_log ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).2 ha0)).symm⟩
      rw [hm] at ha ⊢
      rw [← WithZero.exp_zero, WithZero.exp_lt_exp] at ha
      rw [WithZero.exp_le_exp]
      omega
  · haveI := subsingleton_factor p v h
    ext b
    simp only [factorLogShell, Set.mem_image]
    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨0, by simp, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, fun _ => ⟨0, zero_mem_logShell,
      Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.algEquiv_image_factorLogShell_subset
statement:
theorem algEquiv_image_factorLogShell_subset (σ : Factor K p v ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]] Factor K p v) :
    σ '' factorLogShell p v ⊆ factorLogShell p v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOver K p v
  · letI := padicAlgebra h.residueChar_finPart
    haveI := finite_padicAlgebra h.residueChar_finPart
    haveI : ContinuousSMul ℚ_[p] (completionAt K (finPart K v)) :=
      continuousSMul_of_algebraMap ℚ_[p] _ (continuous_padicEmb h.residueChar_finPart)
    set f := completionAlgEquivFactor p v h
    have hf : ∀ y, f y = factorMk p v y := fun y => rfl
    set τ : completionAt K (finPart K v) ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]] completionAt K (finPart K v) :=
      f.trans (σ.trans f.symm)
    have hτ : Continuous τ := LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional τ.toLinearMap
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨τ y, RingHom.image_logShell_subset p.2
      (norm_natCast_lt_one_completion h.residueChar_finPart) τ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom hτ
      ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hf y, ← hf (τ y)]
    change f (f.symm (σ (f y))) = σ (f y)
    rw [f.apply_symm_apply]
  · haveI := subsingleton_factor p v h
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨0, zero_mem_logShell, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_factorLogShell_coord_bound
statement:
theorem exists_factorLogShell_coord_bound : ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
    ∀ b ∈ factorLogShell p v, ∀ k, ‖(Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)).repr b k‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : IsOver K p v
  · letI := padicAlgebra h.residueChar_finPart
    haveI : ContinuousSMul ℚ_[p] (completionAt K (finPart K v)) :=
      continuousSMul_of_algebraMap ℚ_[p] _ (continuous_padicEmb h.residueChar_finPart)
    haveI := finite_padicAlgebra h.residueChar_finPart
    have hC : IsCompact (closure (Iut.logShell (completionAt K (finPart K v)) p)) :=
      isCompact_closure_logShell p.2 (norm_natCast_lt_one_completion h.residueChar_finPart)
    let g : completionAt K (finPart K v) →ₗ[ℚ_[p]]
        (Fin (Module.finrank ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)) → ℚ_[p]) :=
      (Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)).equivFun.toLinearMap ∘ₗ factorMkₗ p v h
    have hg : Continuous g := LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional g
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hC.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hg.continuousOn
    refine ⟨max M 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ k
    have hga : ‖g a‖ ≤ M := hM a (subset_closure ha)
    calc ‖(Module.finBasis ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v)).repr (factorMk p v a) k‖
        = ‖g a k‖ := by
          simp only [g, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Module.Basis.equivFun_apply]
          rfl
      _ ≤ ‖g a‖ := norm_le_pi_norm _ _
      _ ≤ max M 0 := hga.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · refine ⟨0, le_rfl, fun b _ k => ?_⟩
    haveI := subsingleton_factor p v h
    have : Module.finrank ℚ_[p] (Factor K p v) = 0 := Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
    exact absurd k.2 (by omega)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mem_logShell
statement:
lemma mem_logShell {x : Tensor K (.finite p) c} :
    x ∈ logShell p c ↔ x ∈ logShellSubmodule p c
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.one_mem_logShellSet
statement: lemma one_mem_logShellSet : (1 : Tensor K (.finite p) c) ∈ logShellSet p c
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j => ⟨1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_one (factorMk p (c j))]
    exact factorMk_mem_factorLogShell_of_norm_le_one p (c j) 1 (by simp)
  · rw [PiTensorProduct.one_def]
    rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.logShellSet_subset_logShell
statement: lemma logShellSet_subset_logShell : logShellSet p c ⊆ logShell p c
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, one_mem_integral p c, x, hx, one_mul x⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.tensorLogShell_subset_logShell
statement: lemma tensorLogShell_subset_logShell : tensorLogShell p c ⊆ logShell p c
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.mpr (logShellSet_subset_logShell p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.integralSet_subset_logShellSet
statement: lemma integralSet_subset_logShellSet : integralSet p c ⊆ logShellSet p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨fun j => ⟨factorMk p (c j) (a j).1,
    factorMk_mem_factorLogShell_of_norm_le_one p (c j) (a j).1 (a j).2⟩, rfl⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.order_subset_tensorLogShell
statement: theorem order_subset_tensorLogShell : order p c ⊆ tensorLogShell p c
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono (integralSet_subset_logShellSet p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.order_subset_logShell
statement: theorem order_subset_logShell : order p c ⊆ logShell p c
proof:
:=
  (order_subset_tensorLogShell p c).trans (tensorLogShell_subset_logShell p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.integral_subset_logShell
statement: theorem integral_subset_logShell : integral p c ⊆ logShell p c
proof:
:= fun a ha =>
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, ha, 1, one_mem_logShellSet p c, mul_one a⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mul_mem_logShell
statement:
theorem mul_mem_logShell {a x : Tensor K (.finite p) c} (ha : a ∈ integral p c)
    (hx : x ∈ logShell p c) : a * x ∈ logShell p c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_logShell] at hx ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨a * b, mul_mem_integral p c ha hb, y, hy, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [mul_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [mul_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change a * ((r : ℚ_[p]) • x) ∈ _
    rw [mul_smul_comm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.coe_logShellAddSubgroup
statement:
lemma coe_logShellAddSubgroup :
    (logShellAddSubgroup p c : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) = logShell p c
proof: := rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isOpen_logShell
statement: lemma isOpen_logShell : IsOpen (logShell p c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := exists_closedBall_subset_order p c
  rw [← coe_logShellAddSubgroup]
  exact AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds _ (Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds 0 hr)
    (hsub.trans (order_subset_logShell p c)))

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isClosed_logShell
statement: lemma isClosed_logShell : IsClosed (logShell p c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_logShellAddSubgroup]
  exact AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_isOpen _ (isOpen_logShell p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.span_subset_closedBall_of_forall_norm_le
statement:
lemma span_subset_closedBall_of_forall_norm_le (s : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ‖x‖ ≤ M) :
    (Submodule.span ℤ_[p] s : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 M
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact hs x hx
  | zero => simpa using hM
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max x y).trans (max_le hx hy)
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change ‖(r : ℚ_[p]) • x‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_smul]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (PadicInt.norm_le_one r)).trans hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_norm_logShellSet_le
statement:
lemma exists_norm_logShellSet_le :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ logShellSet p c, ‖x‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  choose C hC0 hC using fun j => exists_factorLogShell_coord_bound p (c j)
  refine ⟨∏ j, C j, Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hC0 j, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  change ‖(packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c).equivFun
    (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p] fun j => (a j : Factor K p (c j)))‖ ≤ _
  rw [pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg fun j _ => hC0 j)]
  intro k
  rw [Module.Basis.equivFun_apply]
  unfold packetBasis
  rw [Basis.piTensorProduct_repr_tprod_apply, norm_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_le_prod (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _) fun j _ => hC j _ (a j).2 _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_norm_mul_logShellSet_le
statement:
lemma exists_norm_mul_logShellSet_le :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ integral p c * logShellSet p c, ‖x‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M₀, -, hM₀⟩ := exists_norm_logShellSet_le p c
  have hS : Bornology.IsBounded (logShellSet p c) := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr ⟨M₀, hM₀⟩
  have hc : IsCompact (integral p c * closure (logShellSet p c)) :=
    (isCompact_integral p c).mul hS.isCompact_closure
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mp hc.isBounded
  exact ⟨max M 0, le_max_right _ _, fun x hx =>
    (hM x (Set.mul_subset_mul_left subset_closure hx)).trans (le_max_left _ _)⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_logShell_subset_closedBall
statement: lemma exists_logShell_subset_closedBall : ∃ M : ℝ, logShell p c ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ := exists_norm_mul_logShellSet_le p c
  exact ⟨M, span_subset_closedBall_of_forall_norm_le p c _ M hM0 hM⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isBounded_logShell
statement: lemma isBounded_logShell : Bornology.IsBounded (logShell p c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_logShell_subset_closedBall p c
  exact (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨M, hM⟩

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isCompact_logShell
statement: lemma isCompact_logShell : IsCompact (logShell p c)
proof:
:=
  Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded (isClosed_logShell p c) (isBounded_logShell p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isCompact_closure_logShell
statement: lemma isCompact_closure_logShell : IsCompact (closure (logShell p c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isClosed_logShell p c).closure_eq]
  exact isCompact_logShell p c

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.haar_logShell_pos
statement: lemma haar_logShell_pos : 0 < haar (.finite p) c (logShell p c)
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le ((isOpen_order p c).measure_pos _ (order_nonempty p c))
    (measure_mono (order_subset_logShell p c))

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.logShellSet_subset_order_of_unramified
statement:
theorem logShellSet_subset_order_of_unramified (hodd : Odd (p : ℕ))
    (hunr : ∀ j w, c j = Place.finite w → ramIdx K w = 1) : logShellSet p c ⊆ order p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have : ∀ j, ∃ y : completionAt K (finPart K (c j)), ‖y‖ ≤ 1 ∧ factorMk p (c j) y = a j := by
    intro j
    have hmem : ((a j : Factor K p (c j))) ∈ factorMk p (c j) '' Metric.closedBall 0 1 := by
      rw [← factorLogShell_eq_of_unramified p (c j) hodd (hunr j)]
      exact (a j).2
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨y, by simpa using hy, hy'⟩
  choose y hy hy' using this
  have : (PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p] fun j => (a j : Factor K p (c j))) =
      tprodIntegral p c fun j => ⟨y j, hy j⟩ := by
    unfold tprodIntegral
    exact congrArg _ (funext fun j => (hy' j).symm)
  change PiTensorProduct.tprod ℚ_[p] (fun j => (a j : Factor K p (c j))) ∈ order p c
  rw [this]
  exact tprodIntegral_mem p c _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.tensorLogShell_eq_order_of_unramified
statement:
theorem tensorLogShell_eq_order_of_unramified (hodd : Odd (p : ℕ))
    (hunr : ∀ j w, c j = Place.finite w → ramIdx K w = 1) : tensorLogShell p c = order p c
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (Submodule.span_le.mpr (logShellSet_subset_order_of_unramified p c hodd hunr))
    (order_subset_tensorLogShell p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.logShell_eq_integral_of_unramified
statement:
theorem logShell_eq_integral_of_unramified (hodd : Odd (p : ℕ))
    (hunr : ∀ j w, c j = Place.finite w → ramIdx K w = 1) : logShell p c = integral p c
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm ?_ (integral_subset_logShell p c)
  change (logShellSubmodule p c : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ⊆
    (Subalgebra.toSubmodule (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) :
      Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c))
  refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact mul_mem_integral p c ha
    (order_subset_integral p c (logShellSet_subset_order_of_unramified p c hodd hunr hx))

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mapAlgHom_image_logShell_subset
statement:
theorem mapAlgHom_image_logShell_subset
    (σ : ∀ j, Factor K p (c j) ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]] Factor K p (c j)) :
    mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ '' logShell p c ⊆ logShell p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_logShell] at hx ⊢
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha, _, ⟨b, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [map_mul, mapAlgHom_tprod]
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, mapAlgHom_image_integral_subset p c σ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩, _,
      ⟨fun j => ⟨σ j (b j), algEquiv_image_factorLogShell_subset p (c j) (σ j)
        ⟨_, (b j).2, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ ((r : ℚ_[p]) • x) ∈ _
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.indAut_logShell
statement: theorem indAut_logShell : ∀ φ ∈ indAut (.finite p) c, φ '' logShell p c ⊆ logShell p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩
  exact mapAlgHom_image_logShell_subset p c σ

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.thetaShell_admissible
statement:
theorem thetaShell_admissible :
    (⋃ φ ∈ indAut (.finite p) c, φ '' logShell p c) ∈ admissible (.finite p) c
proof:
:=
  iUnion_indAut_admissible (.finite p) c (isCompact_logShell p c) (haar_logShell_pos p c)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.PiTensorProduct.formallyUnramified
statement:
theorem PiTensorProduct.formallyUnramified {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (A : ι → Type*) [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra.FormallyUnramified R (A i)] :
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified R (⨂[R] i, A i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Algebra.FormallyUnramified.iff_comp_injective]
  intro B _ _ I hI f g hfg
  refine PiTensorProduct.algHom_ext fun i => ?_
  apply Algebra.FormallyUnramified.comp_injective I hI
  ext x
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun hfg (PiTensorProduct.singleAlgHom i x)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.formallyUnramified_completion
statement:
lemma formallyUnramified_completion {w : FinitePlace K} (hw : residueChar w = (p : ℕ)) :
    letI
proof:
:= padicAlgebra hw
    Algebra.FormallyUnramified ℚ_[p] (completionAt K w) := by
  letI := padicAlgebra hw
  haveI := finite_padicAlgebra hw
  exact Algebra.FormallyUnramified.of_isSeparable ℚ_[p] (completionAt K w)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.toSubmodule_orderSubalgebra
statement:
lemma toSubmodule_orderSubalgebra :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule (orderSubalgebra p c) = orderSubmodule p c
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ext fun _ => Iff.rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.fg_of_subset_closedBall
statement:
theorem fg_of_subset_closedBall (N : Submodule ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) (M : ℝ)
    (hN : (N : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 M) : N.FG
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : (p : ℕ).Prime).one_lt
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt M hp1
  set q : ℚ_[p] := ((p : ℕ) : ℚ_[p]) ^ n with hq
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast (Fact.out : (p : ℕ).Prime).ne_zero)
  have hqnorm : ‖q‖ = ((p : ℝ) ^ n)⁻¹ := by rw [hq, norm_pow, Padic.norm_p, inv_pow]
  set L : Submodule ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c) :=
    Submodule.span ℤ_[p] (Set.range fun k =>
      (q⁻¹ • packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c k : Tensor K (.finite p) c)) with hL
  have hLfg : L.FG := Submodule.fg_span (Set.finite_range _)
  have hNL : N ≤ L := by
    intro x hx
    have hxM : ‖x‖ ≤ M := by simpa using hN hx
    rw [← (packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c).sum_equivFun x]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
    have hk : ‖(packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c).equivFun x k * q‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [norm_mul, hqnorm, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_one (by positivity)]
      refine le_trans ?_ hn.le
      exact (norm_le_pi_norm _ k).trans (by rw [← norm_def]; exact hxM)
    let r : ℤ_[p] := ⟨_, hk⟩
    have : (packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c).equivFun x k •
          packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c k =
        r • (q⁻¹ • packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c k : Tensor K (.finite p) c) := by
      change _ = ((packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c).equivFun x k * q) •
        (q⁻¹ • packetBasis (RationalPlace.finite p) c k : Tensor K (.finite p) c)
      rw [smul_smul, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hq0, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r (Submodule.subset_span ⟨k, rfl⟩)
  haveI : IsNoetherian ℤ_[p] L := isNoetherian_of_fg_of_noetherian L hLfg
  have h := (IsNoetherian.noetherian (N.comap L.subtype)).map L.subtype
  rwa [Submodule.map_comap_subtype, inf_eq_right.mpr hNL] at h

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.orderSubmodule_fg
statement: theorem orderSubmodule_fg : (orderSubmodule p c).FG
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_order_subset_closedBall p c
  exact fg_of_subset_closedBall p c _ M hM

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isIntegral_of_mem_order
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_mem_order {x : Tensor K (.finite p) c} (hx : x ∈ order p c) :

proof:
:=
  IsIntegral.of_mem_of_fg (orderSubalgebra p c)
    (by rw [toSubmodule_orderSubalgebra]; exact orderSubmodule_fg p c) x hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mem_integral
statement: lemma mem_integral {x : Tensor K (.finite p) c} : x ∈ integral p c ↔ IsIntegral ℤ_[p] x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.order_subset_integral

:= fun _ hx =>
  isIntegral_of_mem_order p c hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.one_mem_integral
statement: lemma one_mem_integral : (1 : Tensor K (.finite p) c) ∈ integral p c

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mul_mem_integral
statement:
lemma mul_mem_integral {x y : Tensor K (.finite p) c} (hx : x ∈ integral p c)
    (hy : y ∈ integral p c) : x * y ∈ integral p c

:=
  (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)).mul_mem hx hy

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.integral_nonempty

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.incl_mem_integral
statement:
lemma incl_mem_integral (j : ι) (w : FinitePlace K) (h : c j = Place.finite w)
    (x : completionAt K w) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : incl p c j w h x ∈ integral p c
proof:
:=
  order_subset_integral p c (incl_mem_order p c j w h x hx)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.smul_integral_subset
statement:
lemma smul_integral_subset (j : ι) (w : FinitePlace K) (h : c j = Place.finite w)
    (x : completionAt K w) (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) :
    incl p c j w h x • integral p c ⊆ integral p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact mul_mem_integral p c (incl_mem_integral p c j w h x hx) hy

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.smul_integral_subset_of_ordp
statement:
lemma smul_integral_subset_of_ordp (j : ι) (w : FinitePlace K) (h : c j = Place.finite w)
    (x : completionAt K w) (_hx : x ≠ 0) (hord : 0 ≤ ordp K w x) :
    incl p c j w h x • integral p c ⊆ integral p c
proof:
:=
  smul_integral_subset p c j w h x (norm_le_one_of_ordp_nonneg hord)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.mapAlgHom_image_integral_subset
statement:
theorem mapAlgHom_image_integral_subset
    (σ : ∀ j, Factor K p (c j) ≃ₐ[ℚ_[p]] Factor K p (c j)) :
    mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ '' integral p c ⊆ integral p c
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  refine IsIntegral.map_of_comp_eq (RingHom.id ℤ_[p]) (mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ).toRingHom
    (RingHom.ext fun r => ?_) hx
  exact ((mapAlgHom (.finite p) c σ).commutes (r : ℚ_[p])).symm

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.finite_integralClosure_quotient
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure_quotient (I : MaximalSpectrum (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) :
    Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c ⧸ I.asIdeal))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := I.isMaximal
  letI : Field (Tensor K (.finite p) c ⧸ I.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.field I.asIdeal
  haveI : Module.Finite ℚ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c ⧸ I.asIdeal) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℚ_[p] I.asIdeal).toLinearMap
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  haveI : IsNoetherian ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c ⧸ I.asIdeal)) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isNoetherian ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c ⧸ I.asIdeal) _
  infer_instance

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.eq_of_forall_quotient_mk_eq
proof:
:=
  (IsArtinianRing.equivPi _).injective (funext fun I => h I)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.finite_integralClosure
statement:
theorem finite_integralClosure :
    Module.Finite ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := fun I => finite_integralClosure_quotient p c I
  let ρ : integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c) →ₗ[ℤ_[p]]
      ∀ I : MaximalSpectrum (Tensor K (.finite p) c),
        integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c ⧸ I.asIdeal) :=
    { toFun := fun x I => ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk I.asIdeal x,
        IsIntegral.map_of_comp_eq (RingHom.id ℤ_[p]) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I.asIdeal)
          (RingHom.ext fun _ => rfl) x.2⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => by
        funext I
        exact Subtype.ext (map_add _ _ _)
      map_smul' := fun r x => by
        funext I
        exact Subtype.ext (Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul _ r _) }
  have hρ : Function.Injective ρ := by
    intro x y hxy
    refine Subtype.ext (eq_of_forall_quotient_mk_eq p c fun I => ?_)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hxy I)
  haveI : IsNoetherian ℤ_[p] (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) :=
    isNoetherian_of_injective ρ hρ
  infer_instance

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_span_subset_closedBall
statement:
lemma exists_span_subset_closedBall (s : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, (Submodule.span ℤ_[p] s : Set (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ⊆
      Metric.closedBall 0 M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (hs.image norm).bddAbove
  refine ⟨max M 0, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx => exact (hM ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => exact (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max x y).trans (max_le hx hy)
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    change ‖(r : ℚ_[p]) • x‖ ≤ _
    rw [norm_smul]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (PadicInt.norm_le_one r)).trans hx

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.exists_integral_subset_closedBall
statement:
theorem exists_integral_subset_closedBall :
    ∃ M : ℝ, integral p c ⊆ Metric.closedBall 0 M
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finite_integralClosure p c
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.Finite.fg_top (R := ℤ_[p])
    (M := integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c))
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_span_subset_closedBall p c
    ((integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)).val '' (s : Set _))
    (s.finite_toSet.image _)
  refine ⟨M, fun x hx => hM ?_⟩
  have hmem : (⟨x, hx⟩ : integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)) ∈
      Submodule.span ℤ_[p] (s : Set _) := hs ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  have := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem
    (f := (integralClosure ℤ_[p] (Tensor K (.finite p) c)).val.toLinearMap) hmem
  rw [← Submodule.span_image] at this
  exact this

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.isBounded_integral
statement: lemma isBounded_integral : Bornology.IsBounded (integral p c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_integral_subset_closedBall p c
  exact (Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0).mpr ⟨M, hM⟩

  exact AddSubgroup.isOpen_of_mem_nhds _ (Filter.mem_of_superset (Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds 0 hr)
    (hsub.trans (order_subset_integral p c)))

proof:

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.natCast_mem_maximalIdeal_iff
statement:
lemma natCast_mem_maximalIdeal_iff (n : ℕ) :
    (n : 𝓞 K) ∈ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ↔ residueChar w ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  haveI : CharP (𝓞 K ⧸ w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) (residueChar w) := ringChar.charP _

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.not_dvd_den_of_norm_le_one
statement: lemma not_dvd_den_of_norm_le_one {q : ℚ} (hq : ‖(q : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1) : ¬ p ∣ q.den
proof:
:= by
  intro hden
  have hp := (Fact.out : p.Prime)
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp [Nat.Prime.ne_one hp] at hden
  have hnum : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ q.num := by
    intro h
    have h' : p ∣ q.num.natAbs := by
      have := Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr h
      simpa using this
    have hg : p ∣ Nat.gcd q.num.natAbs q.den := Nat.dvd_gcd h' hden
    rw [Nat.Coprime.gcd_eq_one q.reduced] at hg
    exact hp.ne_one (Nat.dvd_one.mp hg)
  have hval : padicValRat p q = -(padicValNat p q.den : ℤ) := by
    unfold padicValRat
    rw [padicValInt.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hnum]
    simp
  have h1 : 1 ≤ padicValNat p q.den := one_le_padicValNat_of_dvd q.den_nz hden
  rw [Padic.eq_padicNorm, padicNorm.eq_zpow_of_nonzero hq0, hval, neg_neg] at hq
  have : (1 : ℚ) < (p : ℚ) ^ ((padicValNat p q.den : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    rw [zpow_natCast]
    exact one_lt_pow₀ (by exact_mod_cast hp.one_lt) (by omega)
  have hq' : ((p : ℚ) ^ ((padicValNat p q.den : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hq
  exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le this hq') (lt_irrefl _)

name: Iut.LocalConstruct.ratHom_apply
statement:
lemma ratHom_apply (x : WithVal (Rat.padicValuation p)) :
